In order to investigate the applicability and compare the model's performance with advanced automotive radar tracking methods, a radar data set using series sensors and pre-crash relevant scenarios was recorded. The results demonstrate the advantages of the anchor-based AI model over established tracking approaches. It excels at estimating object parameters in dynamic scenarios and underscores its ability to process different data sets effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于锚点的AI模型，利用高分辨率雷达的微多普勒特征来改善预碰撞场景下的物体检测和运动参数估计，并通过雷达图像膨胀技术增强局部特征，实验证明其优于传统跟踪方法。
AI.motivation: 高级自动驾驶需要可靠的安全系统（如智能气囊和自适应安全带）的及时激活，而这依赖于前视传感器对物体的快速精确检测。传统雷达跟踪方法在动态场景中可能产生误判或漏检，尤其是在近场关键区域，因此需要更先进的技术来提升检测和参数估计的准确性。
AI.method: 采用锚点（anchor-based）AI模型处理高分辨率雷达数据，特别关注微多普勒特征；为了解决雷达点云的稀疏和波动问题，创新性地在特征输入通道上应用雷达图像膨胀技术，以放大局部雷达模式（如微多普勒特征）。
AI.result: 实验表明，该锚点AI模型在动态场景中估计物体参数方面优于先进的汽车雷达跟踪方法，能有效处理不同数据集，并减少近场误检（漏检），提高系统可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 基于微多普勒特征的锚点AI模型能够提升预碰撞物体检测和参数估计的准确性，增强高级自动驾驶安全系统的可靠性，为未来汽车安全技术提供了一种有效方案。

title: GRACE: LLM-Grounded Semantic Metric Spaces for Scalable Mixed-Data Clustering
summary: Clustering mixed tabular data requires a unified metric space to bridge the inherent heterogeneity between continuous numerical measurements and discrete categorical symbols. Traditionally, algorithms rely entirely on dataset-internal statistics to estimate categorical relationships, which confines the learned metric to empirical co-occurrences and ignores conceptually obvious yet statistically unobserved affinities. Although LLMs offer external world knowledge, applying their text-centric reasoning to highly abstract tabular concepts presents significant challenges. Bridging this modality gap to construct a semantically complete metric typically requires embedding LLMs into iterative metric learning loops to dynamically optimize cross-modality representations. This incurs intractable computational overhead, forcing a compromise between semantic enrichment and scalability. Therefore, we propose GRACE, an LLM-grounded framework for scalable mixed-data clustering. GRACE shifts semantic acquisition to the attribute-value level via a multi-perspective LLM querying strategy, mapping heterogeneous values into knowledge-informed descriptions. Crucially, this one-shot grounding extracts general-purpose semantic representations that embed heterogeneous attributes into a unified space, decoupling expensive LLM invocation from iterative optimization. Furthermore, GRACE cross-validates these external semantics against dataset-internal statistical evidence to ensure alignment with the dataset-specific cluster structure. Ultimately, GRACE matches the scalability of conventional statistics-driven baselines while achieving superior clustering accuracy and conceptual interpretability over 11 competing methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/develop-yang/GRACE-GRACE-A

AI.tldr: 提出GRACE框架，利用LLM在属性值级别一次性生成语义表示，将混合表格数据映射到统一空间，避免迭代优化开销，同时保持可扩展性和聚类性能。
AI.motivation: 混合表格数据聚类缺乏统一度量空间，传统方法依赖内部统计，无法捕捉未观察到的语义关系；LLM提供外部知识但存在模态差距和计算开销问题。
AI.method: 采用多视角LLM查询策略，将异构属性值转化为知识描述，一次性生成通用语义表示，并与数据集内部统计证据交叉验证以保证对齐。
AI.result: 在11个竞争方法中，GRACE达到与统计驱动基线相当的扩展性，同时聚类准确性和概念可解释性更优。
AI.conclusion: GRACE成功利用LLM外部知识提升混合数据聚类，且无需迭代优化，兼顾语义丰富性和可扩展性，代码已开源。

title: North Africa's Missing Framework: NLP-Driven Mental Healthcare in Algeria and Implications for Low-resource Settings
summary: Mental health disorders are a leading cause of disability worldwide, yet Natural Language Processing (NLP) research for mental healthcare has remained concentrated in high-income, English-language settings. North Africa, and Algeria in particular, is largely absent from this literature despite its unique linguistic, historical, and healthcare context. We present the first conceptual framework examining the potential role of NLP within Algeria's mental healthcare system. Drawing on narrative synthesis of global NLP mental health research, Algerian healthcare literature, and low-resource NLP methodologies, we identify four structural barriers to mental healthcare: the language-of-care gap, geographic inequities in access, stigma-related barriers to help-seeking, and the absence of research and digital infrastructure. We then map existing NLP capabilities to each barrier, outlining their potential applications, implementation constraints, and the technical, institutional, and governance requirements necessary for deployment. Based on this analysis, we propose a research and policy roadmap that prioritizes data resources, multilingual language technologies, evaluation frameworks, and regulatory capacity. Although grounded in the Algerian context, the framework addresses challenges common to many multilingual, low-resource, and post-colonial settings. This work provides a foundation for future research on culturally and linguistically appropriate NLP for mental healthcare and offers a practical roadmap for developing responsible AI-enabled mental health systems in underrepresented regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对阿尔及利亚心理健康医疗的NLP概念框架，识别了四大结构性障碍，并规划了技术应用与政策路线图。
AI.motivation: 全球NLP心理健康研究集中于高收入英语国家，阿尔及利亚等北非地区被忽视，尽管其语言、历史与医疗背景独特，面临特殊挑战。
AI.method: 采用叙事综合法，整合全球NLP心理健康研究、阿尔及利亚医疗文献和低资源NLP方法，识别障碍并映射NLP能力。
AI.result: 识别出语言护理鸿沟、地理不平等、污名化障碍和基础设施缺失四大障碍，并提出了包含数据资源、多语言技术、评估框架和监管能力的路线图。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多语言、低资源及后殖民背景下的心理健康NLP研究奠定了基础，为欠发达地区构建负责任AI心理健康系统提供了实用指导。

title: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate robot controls autoregressively, making closed-loop latency dominated by repeated target-model forward passes. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by verifying blocks of draft action tokens in parallel, and recent VLA methods further relax token-level acceptance because small differences in action-token space often map to similar continuous controls. However, this relaxation remains scene-agnostic. A fixed token-distance tolerance treats the same action-token deviation as equally safe across states, although deviations that are harmless in free space can cause collisions or grasp failures near contact. We propose WA-SpecDec, a world-aware speculative decoding framework that injects world-model-derived physical scene awareness during the VLA prefill stage, producing shared world-aware prefill states for draft proposal and target verification without changing the relaxed acceptance rule. Across three state-of-the-art relaxed acceptance schemes, WA-SpecDec preserves higher task success under looser relaxation and enables longer accepted prefixes. At comparable-success operating points, WA-SpecDec achieves a 1.5x matched-success speedup over VLA speculative decoding alone and reduces near-contact failure (NCF) by 18.6% on average relative to the corresponding speculative baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种世界感知推测解码框架WA-SpecDec，通过注入世界模型物理场景信息，在不改变宽松接受规则的情况下，提高VLA策略在近距离接触任务中的安全性和效率，实现1.5倍加速并减少18.6%近接触失败。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA推测解码在验证动作token时采用固定距离容忍度，忽略了场景差异，导致在接近接触区域可能发生碰撞或抓取失败。
AI.method: 在VLA预填充阶段注入世界模型派生的物理场景感知，生成共享的世界感知预填充状态，用于草稿提议和目标验证，保持宽松接受规则不变。
AI.result: 在三种宽松接受方案上，WA-SpecDec在更宽松的容忍度下保持更高任务成功率，支持更长接受前缀；在同等成功率下实现1.5倍匹配成功加速，平均减少18.6%近接触失败。
AI.conclusion: WA-SpecDec通过世界感知增强了推测解码的安全性和效率，验证了场景感知在VLA加速中的重要性。

title: Hierarchical Topology-Aware Planning and Control of Underwater Vehicle-Manipulator Systems in Confined Environments
summary: This paper addresses autonomous intervention with an underwater vehicle--manipulator system (UVMS) in confined, cluttered, and partially known environments, where poor maneuverability, narrow passages, and uncertain execution may cause the robot to enter unrecoverable regions. We propose MANTA, a three-layer hierarchical planning-and-control framework that couples passage accessibility, manipulation feasibility, and closed-loop execution. The first layer performs global connectivity reasoning in a conservative reduced base space to extract traversable corridor candidates toward the task region. The second layer refines each candidate corridor by jointly optimizing the continuous base motion and arm trajectory, producing a collision-free base--arm trajectory. The third layer learns a reach-and-hold base policy using Gaussian-process model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) through MC-PILCO, enabling trajectory tracking and station keeping at the planned manipulation state. During execution, the framework monitors map updates and can trigger recovery and route repair when the active passage becomes infeasible. MANTA is evaluated in confined UVMS planning and closed-loop tracking experiments. Across 120 matched planning queries, it achieves higher task success than full-state sampling-based baselines while producing larger clearance margins and lower arm motion. The learned MC-PILCO policy further reduces position and yaw tracking errors on both training and unseen tube-like references. These results show MANTA as a structured and data-efficient framework for safe autonomous underwater intervention in caves, tubes, and cluttered subsea structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MANTA，一个三层分层规划与控制框架，用于在受限、杂乱且部分已知的水下环境中实现自主干预，通过全局连通性推理、轨迹优化和模型强化学习策略，提高任务成功率并降低跟踪误差。
AI.motivation: 水下车辆-机械臂系统在狭窄、杂乱的环境中操作时，机动性差、通道窄且执行不确定，容易进入不可恢复区域，现有方法缺乏对连通性、操作可行性和闭环执行的综合考量。
AI.method: MANTA框架包含三层：第一层在保守降维基空间中执行全局连通性推理，提取可行通道候选；第二层联合优化基座运动和机械臂轨迹，生成无碰撞轨迹；第三层使用基于高斯过程模型的强化学习（MC-PILCO）学习到达和保持基座策略，实现轨迹跟踪和定点保持，并具备恢复和路径修复机制。
AI.result: 在120个匹配规划查询中，MANTA比全状态采样基线实现更高任务成功率，同时产生更大间隙余量和更低机械臂运动；MC-PILCO策略在训练和未见管状参考上均降低位置和偏航跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: MANTA是结构化和数据高效的框架，适用于洞穴、管道和杂乱海底结构中的安全自主水下干预。

title: BRUCE: Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation for Scientific Vision-Language Reasoning
summary:
Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. In this paper, we aim at analyzing VLMs' robustness by applying perturbations and distortions to the input images, such as blur or low contrast. Toward this goal, we propose BRUCE (Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation, a multimodal reasoning fragility framework for scientific vision-language reasoning.
  State-of-the-art evaluation frameworks/studies primarily focus on clean-task accuracy and rarely analyze how reasoning stability degrades across robustness dimensions. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling. We evaluate BRUCE across chemistry and mathematical reasoning tasks for multiple datasets, while analyzing corruption-induced prediction failures in terms of four high-level reasoning domains: OCR-dependent reasoning, spatial reasoning, symbolic reasoning, and semantic failures, with each containing fine-grained corruption specific failure subtypes, thereby enabling an interpretable failure analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRUCE框架，用于评估视觉-语言模型在图像扰动下的鲁棒性，并引入RCI和T-RCI指标量化性能退化，通过细粒度失败分析揭示推理弱点。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要关注干净任务的准确性，忽略了模型在真实世界中面对低质量图像时的推理稳定性，亟需系统分析鲁棒性退化。
AI.method: 通过施加渐进式扰动（如模糊、低对比度），采用RCI和T-RCI指标，并结合OCR依赖、空间、符号和语义四类推理领域进行可解释的失败分析。
AI.result: 在化学和数学推理任务上，BRUCE成功揭示了不同VLM的鲁棒性差异及推理失败模式，显示模型性能随扰动加剧而显著下降。
AI.conclusion: BRUCE提供了一种全面的鲁棒性评估方法，有助于识别VLM在科学推理中的脆弱性，并为提升其实际应用可靠性指明方向。

title: Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach
summary: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TdSciNER，一种类型驱动的科学命名实体识别方法，通过实体类型过滤、多任务学习和基于类型多样性的演示选择，提升LLM在科学文本中的NER性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在科学NER中依赖候选实体类型信息，但科学领域实体类型复杂且候选过多时，LLM难以准确识别。
AI.method: 设计实体类型过滤模型筛选可能类型；引入辅助多类实体分类任务进行多任务学习以增强上下文表示；基于句子相似度和类型多样性开发演示选择策略，激活LLM的上下文学习能力。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上达到与全监督模型相当的性能，且各类型驱动组件均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: TdSciNER有效利用实体类型信息提升科学NER性能，为科学文本挖掘提供启示。

title: From Operational Design Domain to Action: A Systematic Behavioral Taxonomy for Autonomous Driving
summary: Operational Design Domain (ODD) specifications describe where an automated driving system (ADS) is permitted to operate, but they do not prescribe what the ADS must demonstrably do once deployed within that domain. This gap between operating condition specification and behavioral validation represents a critical unresolved challenge in ADS safety assurance. This paper presents a structured, standards-grounded taxonomy of 21 behavioral competencies organized across three operational domains-Highway (HWY), Urban (URB), and Hub (HUB)-derived systematically from the PEGASUS six-layer model-based ODD. Each behavior is decomposed along longitudinal and lateral control axes and characterized against a four-property framework: Safety (gap maintenance, conflict avoidance, kinematic stability), Compliance (legal rules and behavioral norms), Comfort (rider dynamics and trust), and Efficiency (mission completion and product-level metrics). We further demonstrate that the crossing of ODD layer parameterizations with behavioral competency specifications yields concrete scenario families suitable for systematic behavioral testing and SOTIF coverage evidence. The taxonomy is grounded in AVSC00008202111, SAE J3237, and SAE J3016, and is validated as an operational specification layer through its deployment in a rule-enforced trajectory optimization system. The Hub domain is identified as a structurally distinct, underspecified domain warranting dedicated research attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于PEGASUS六层模型的结构化行为能力分类体系，涵盖21项行为能力和三个操作域，并验证了其在规则约束轨迹优化系统中的应用，以弥补自动系统操作规范与行为验证之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 操作设计域（ODD）规范仅定义自动驾驶系统（ADS）允许运行的环境，但未规定系统在该域内必须展示的行为，导致ADS安全保证中的关键缺口。
AI.method: 从PEGASUS六层模型系统推导出21项行为能力，按纵向和横向控制轴分解，并用安全性、合规性、舒适性和效率四个属性进行刻画，同时结合ODD参数化生成场景族，用于系统化行为测试和SOTIF覆盖证据。
AI.result: 该分类体系在规则约束轨迹优化系统中得到验证，并发现Hub域是结构上独特且未被充分定义的域，需专门研究。
AI.conclusion: 提出的行为分类体系可作为操作规范层，弥补ODD与行为验证之间的缺口，并指出Hub域需进一步关注。

title: Reason Wide, Not Deep: Amortizing the Reasoning Premium into Distilled Skills
summary: Reasoning modes of language models outperform their non-reasoning counterparts on multi-step agentic tasks, but pay a 3-6x premium in output tokens on every episode -- much of it spent re-deriving procedures that are shared across episodes of the same domain. We show this recurring cost can be amortized: a coding agent analyses a small corpus of existing trajectories from a training split and compiles a compact natural-language skill that is injected into the non-reasoning model's system prompt. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, tau$^2$-bench telecom and retail, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), skills recover 55%-100%+ of the reasoning gap for GPT-5.4-mini on held-out tasks -- exceeding the reasoning mode outright on two of four -- while emitting 2.7-6x fewer output tokens and zero reasoning tokens. Notably, reasoning traces are not a prerequisite: skills distilled from non-reasoning trajectories alone remain competitive with skills distilled from paired reasoning/non-reasoning corpora, with domain-dependent differences between the two sources. We interpret these results through a search lens: test-time reasoning is deep search inside a single episode, re-paid at every deployment, while corpus distillation is wide search across episodes, paid once. The two recover overlapping procedural knowledge, and width over cheap trajectories is often the better buy -- with the residual gap on some domains (telecom, SpreadsheetBench) delineating where genuinely per-instance deep search remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过从少量现有轨迹中提炼自然语言技能并注入非推理模型的系统提示，来摊销跨episode的推理成本，在四个智能体基准上恢复了55%-100%以上的推理差距，同时减少了2.7-6倍的输出token。
AI.motivation: 推理模式的语言模型在多步智能体任务上表现更好，但每次episode需支付3-6倍的输出token，且大量token用于重复推导同一领域的共享流程，这种重复成本可以也应该被摊销。
AI.method: 编码智能体分析训练集的小规模轨迹语料，编译成紧凑的自然语言技能，并注入非推理模型的系统提示中；比较了从推理与非推理轨迹中提炼技能的效果。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、tau²-bench（电信和零售）及SpreadsheetBench-Verified上，技能恢复了55%-100%+的推理差距，其中两个基准超过推理模式；输出token减少2.7-6倍，且推理token为零；从非推理轨迹提炼的技能与从配对推理/非推理语料提炼的技能竞争力相当，存在领域差异。
AI.conclusion: 测试时推理是单episode内的深度搜索，每次部署都要重付；语料提炼是跨episode的宽度搜索，只付一次。两者恢复的程序性知识重叠，宽度搜索廉价轨迹往往更划算，但在某些领域（电信、SpreadsheetBench）残留差距说明真正需要逐实例深度搜索。

title: OnEvoMemory: Evolving Memory through Online Robot Rollouts for Pretrained Robot Policies
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Embodied Multimodal Reasoning in Physical Environments (EMR)
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires policies to track completed subtasks and critical interaction events. However, existing memory mechanisms heavily rely on external models or predefined update rules. To address this, we propose OnEvoMemory, a value-guided memory module for pretrained robot policies. It maintains recent context, high-value experiences, and salient transitions, while learning which experiences should be retained from trajectory outcomes. Offline demonstrations initialize the memory prior, whereas successful and unsuccessful online rollouts refine memory selection, helping the policy recognize task-stage transitions and avoid repeating completed subtasks. Experiments on long-horizon manipulation benchmarks show that OnEvoMemory improves the performance of the base VLA policy through both offline initialization and online memory evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OnEvoMemory，一种价值引导的记忆模块，用于增强预训练机器人策略在长时程操作任务中的表现。该模块通过维护近期上下文、高价值经验和显著转换，并学习从轨迹结果中保留哪些经验，利用离线演示初始化记忆，在线 rollout 细化记忆选择，帮助策略识别任务阶段转换并避免重复已完成子任务。实验表明，该方法在长时程操作基准上有效提升了基础VLA策略的性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要策略跟踪已完成子任务和关键交互事件，但现有记忆机制过度依赖外部模型或预定义更新规则，缺乏自适应性和价值导向，限制了策略在复杂任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出OnEvoMemory价值引导记忆模块，包含：1) 维护近期上下文、高价值经验和显著转换；2) 学习从轨迹结果中决定保留哪些经验；3) 使用离线演示初始化记忆先验；4) 通过成功与失败的在线 rollout 细化记忆选择，帮助策略识别阶段转换并避免重复已完成子任务。
AI.result: 在长时程操作基准上，OnEvoMemory通过离线初始化和在线记忆进化，显著提升了基础VLA策略的性能。
AI.conclusion: OnEvoMemory通过价值引导的记忆管理，有效增强了预训练策略在长时程操作中的任务阶段感知和子任务避免重复能力，为机器人策略记忆机制提供了新思路。

title: Multi-Task Consistency-based Detection of Adversarial Attacks
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have found successful deployment in numerous vision perception systems. However, their susceptibility to adversarial attacks has prompted concerns regarding their practical applications, specifically in the context of autonomous driving. Existing defenses often suffer from cost inefficiency, rendering their deployment impractical for resource-constrained applications. In this work, we propose an efficient and effective adversarial attack detection scheme leveraging the multi-task perception within a complex vision system. Adversarial perturbations are detected by the inconsistencies between the inference outputs of multiple vision tasks, e.g., object detection and instance segmentation. To this end, we developed a consistency score metric to measure the inconsistency between vision tasks. Next, we designed an approach to select the best model pairs for detecting inconsistencies effectively. Finally, we evaluated our defense against PGD attacks across multiple vision models on the BDD100k validation dataset. The experimental results demonstrated that our defense achieved a ROC-AUC performance of 99.9% detection within the considered attacker model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多任务感知一致性的对抗攻击检测方案，通过检测多个视觉任务（如目标检测和实例分割）输出之间的不一致性来识别对抗样本，并在BDD100k数据集上实现了99.9%的ROC-AUC检测性能。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉感知系统中易受对抗攻击，而现有防御方法成本高，难以应用于资源受限的自动驾驶场景。
AI.method: 利用多任务感知系统，设计一致性评分指标来量化不同视觉任务输出的不一致性，并选择最优的模型组合以有效检测对抗扰动。
AI.result: 在BDD100k验证集上，针对PGD攻击，所提防御方法达到了99.9%的ROC-AUC检测率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多任务一致性检测方案高效且有效，为资源受限的自动驾驶系统提供了一种实用的对抗攻击防御手段。

title: PEEL: Parallel Extraction for Long-Horizon Disassembly Planning via Scale-Invariant Sampling
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://peel-disassembly.surge.sh/
summary: Long-horizon multi-part object disassembly requires robots to compute feasible sequences of collision-free removal motions, even in the presence of tight, narrow escape corridors. To efficiently solve such disassembly problems, we propose Parallel Extraction for Long-Horizon Disassembly (PEEL), an algorithm which efficiently computes disassembly motions for object assemblies and feeds them to a robot manipulator for execution. PEEL uses sampling-based motion planning to compute single-object motions through the use of a scale-invariant sampling scheme, where the object scale is estimated in a burn-in phase and a subsequent directional sampler exploits the scale. This sampling scheme is integrated into a multi-arm bandit rapidly-exploring random tree (MAB-RRT) planner, which switches between different samplers depending on the reward signal received. Using MAB-RRT, the PEEL algorithm runs a batch of planners in parallel to obtain an ordered graph specifying the sequence in which object parts have to be removed. We show that MAB-RRT can efficiently solve single-part disassemblies with 100 percent success rate on 76 assemblies, and that it is robust to its parameters. By integrating MAB-RRT into PEEL, we solve four long-horizon disassembly problems using the Fetch manipulator robot involving 10 to 17 individual object parts.

AI.tldr: 提出PEEL算法，将尺度不变采样与多臂老虎机RRT结合，并行规划长时程多部件拆解序列，并在Fetch机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 长时程多部件拆解需要计算无碰撞的移除运动序列，且存在狭窄的逃逸通道，传统方法效率低下。
AI.method: PEEL算法采用尺度不变采样方案（通过预热阶段估计尺度，然后使用方向性采样器），并集成到多臂老虎机RRT（MAB-RRT）规划器中，根据奖励信号切换采样器，并行运行多个规划器以生成有序拆解图。
AI.result: MAB-RRT在76个装配体上实现100%的单部件拆解成功率，对参数鲁棒；PEEL成功解决了Fetch机器人上10到17个部件的四个长时程拆解问题。
AI.conclusion: PEEL结合MAB-RRT能高效解决长时程多部件拆解问题，适用于机器人操作。

title: TelemetrySuffBench: Is Agent Telemetry Sufficient for Failure-Origin Diagnosis?
summary: Agent systems increasingly expose execution traces, yet telemetry that reveals a failure may still be inadequate for identifying where that failure originated. We introduce TelemetrySuffBench, a controlled benchmark that separates failure detection, fault-origin localization, and safe abstention under insufficient evidence. The benchmark constructs canonical multi-component traces with delayed-binding faults and renders them as paired coarse views, seven-factor telemetry masks, and exact-equal ambiguous origin pairs. We evaluate five frontier language models using unified protocols, explicit candidate sets, invalid-output accounting, subgroup analyses, and a frozen blind holdout. With full telemetry, origin-step Top-1 accuracy ranges from 33.8% to 97.2% across models. Metadata, OpenTelemetry-compatible, and OpenInference-compatible views retain 99.5% to 100% detection F1 while limiting origin-step accuracy to at most 0.5%, exposing a robust detection-localization gap. Factor ablations further show that removing decision content reduces origin-step accuracy to zero for every model, while provenance removal also causes large model-dependent losses. On rich ambiguous inputs that require abstention, evidence gating reduces unsupported unique-origin answers by 12.5 to 48.6 percentage points for three models, whereas two models still answer every case, revealing strong model dependence in safe abstention. Results on the frozen holdout reproduce the central pattern within the same generator family. These findings show that terminal status can support detection, whereas reliable causal attribution requires explicit decision-to-provenance links and abstention safeguards that remain effective across models. The dataset and benchmark implementation are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TelemetrySuffBench-E635/README.md.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TelemetrySuffBench基准，评估大模型在代理系统遥测中的故障检测、故障源定位和安全弃权能力，发现检测与定位之间存在显著差距，并强调决策-来源链接和弃权机制的必要性。
AI.motivation: 代理系统的执行轨迹虽然暴露，但仅凭遥测数据往往无法准确识别故障根源，现有研究缺乏对检测、定位和弃权能力的分离评估，以及不同遥测视图对定位能力影响的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建TelemetrySuffBench基准，包含多组件规范痕迹、延迟绑定故障、七因素遥测掩码及模糊来源对；统一协议评估五个前沿大模型，采用显式候选集、无效输出核算、子组分析及冻结盲测集，并进行因子消融和证据门控测试。
AI.result: 完整遥测下源步骤Top-1准确率从33.8%到97.2%不等；元数据等视图保留检测F1达99.5%-100%，但源步骤准确率最高仅0.5%；去除决策内容使所有模型定位准确率为零；证据门控使三个模型的不支持唯一来源答案降低12.5%-48.6个百分点，但两个模型仍全答。盲测复现核心模式。
AI.conclusion: 终端状态足以支持故障检测，但可靠的因果归因需要显式的决策-来源链接和跨模型有效的弃权保护，揭示了鲁棒的检测-定位差距和模型依赖的安全弃权行为。

title: LoRSA: Toward Generalizable Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Biomedical Downstream Tasks
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables the adaptation of vision foundation models to biomedical tasks under limited computational resources, but a single low-rank update can constrain all task-specific changes to one narrow parameter subspace. This restriction may prevent the model from simultaneously representing globally shared task structure and localized residual directions required for generalization to unseen imaging domains. We introduce LoRSA, a global--residual adaptation framework that jointly learns a dense low-rank component and a dynamically structured-sparse low-rank component. The dense component captures globally coordinated task adaptation, while the structured component provides complementary residual corrections whose support evolves during training. We characterize the representational capacity, approximation properties, rank structure, and singular-subspace complementarity of this decomposition. We evaluate LoRSA for four-class breast-density classification using DINOv3-Base, with VinDr-Mammo as the source domain and MammosighTR and RSNA as unseen external domains. LoRSA remains competitive on the internal validation set and achieves the best external macro-F1 on both target datasets, improving upon the strongest competing method by 2.15 percentage points on MammosighTR and 3.09 percentage points on RSNA. Weight-matrix analysis further shows that approximately $92\%$ of the energy of each adaptation component lies outside the bilateral singular subspace of the other, indicating that the two components learn largely complementary update directions. These results suggest that organizing adaptation capacity into distinct global and residual paths can improve the external-domain generalization of parameter-efficiently adapted biomedical vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoRSA，一种全局-残差参数高效微调框架，通过联合学习密集低秩和动态结构化稀疏低秩组件，提升医学视觉模型在未见外部领域的泛化能力，并在乳腺密度分类任务上取得最优外部性能。
AI.motivation: 参数高效微调在低资源下适应医学视觉任务，但单一低秩更新将任务特定变化限制在狭窄子空间，可能无法同时建模全局共享结构和局部残差方向，从而限制对新成像域的泛化。
AI.method: LoRSA联合学习一个密集低秩组件和一个动态结构化稀疏低秩组件，前者捕捉全局协调适应，后者提供支持度随训练变化的互补残差修正，并分析了其表示能力、逼近性质和奇异子空间互补性。
AI.result: 在DINOv3-Base上，使用VinDr-Mammo作为源域，MammosighTR和RSNA作为外部域，LoRSA在内部验证集上保持竞争力，并在两个外部数据集上取得最佳宏观F1，分别比最强基线高2.15和3.09个百分点；权重分析显示约92%的能量位于组件间的双向奇异子空间之外，表明学习方向高度互补。
AI.conclusion: 将适应能力组织为独立的全局和残差路径可改善参数高效微调医学视觉模型的外部域泛化，LoRSA有效且可解释。

title: The Evolution of Mixture-of-Experts Architectures in Large Language Models: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, and Expert Parallelism
summary: Mixture-of-Experts models increase parameter capacity while keeping the computation activated by each token bounded, but their architectural evolution cannot be explained by a chronological list of model releases alone. This technical survey synthesizes primary papers, official technical reports, and prior surveys to organize modern Mixture-of-Experts systems along five coupled dimensions: expert granularity, expert topology, routing freedom, the scope of load balancing, and execution structure. We describe eight architectural milestones as a dependency graph with six mainline developments and two orthogonal branches, rather than as eight successive generations. We then analyze individual systems through four control planes: Expert Topology, Routing, Balance, and Expert Parallelism. These planes specify which experts exist, which experts process each token, how aggregate load is controlled, and how selected computation is mapped onto physical devices. The framework connects algorithmic choices such as Top-k routing, shared experts, fine-grained experts, and dynamic expert composition with systems concerns including token dispatch, device placement, all-to-all communication, and communication-computation overlap. We conclude with equal-budget pretraining experiments, quality and systems metrics, and open research questions. The main trend is a shift from merely activating more sparse parameters toward decoupling semantic routing, computational budgets, and physical execution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过五个耦合维度和四个控制平面系统梳理了现代Mixture-of-Experts架构，将八个里程碑视为依赖图而非代际，并强调从稀疏参数激活向语义路由、计算预算与物理执行解耦的转变。
AI.motivation: 现有文献多按时间顺序罗列模型，缺乏对MoE架构演化的系统性框架，难以理解设计选择与系统实现的关联。
AI.method: 综合primary papers、技术报告和综述，提出五维分类（专家粒度、拓扑、路由自由度、负载均衡范围、执行结构）及四控制平面（专家拓扑、路由、平衡、专家并行），并以依赖图描述里程碑。
AI.result: 识别出六个主线和两个分支的八个里程碑，并通过同等预算预训练实验展示了质量与系统指标，揭示解耦趋势。
AI.conclusion: MoE的发展核心是从单纯增大稀疏参数激活，转向解耦语义路由、计算预算和物理执行，为未来研究提供开放问题。

title: Control-Oriented Scenario Tree Construction through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multistage stochastic model predictive control (MPC) handles uncertainty by optimizing over a scenario tree, a finite branching approximation of future outcomes constructed from sampled forecasts. To build such a tree, conventional methods focus on matching the underlying probability distribution---e.g., via Wasserstein-based scenario reduction---but improved distributional accuracy does not necessarily yield better control performance. We propose a control-oriented approach that learns scenario tree construction directly from its impact on downstream decisions. Fixing the tree topology, we formulate tree construction as a sequential assignment of sampled scenarios to leaves. This assignment is parameterized by an attention-based policy over the scenario set and trained using reinforcement learning, with closed-loop control profit as the objective. Training is stabilized by an asymmetric critic that leverages realized future trajectories. We evaluate the method on a risk-averse battery arbitrage problem. Across a range of forecast set sizes, the learned construction consistently achieves the highest profit, outperforming classical forward and backward reduction methods and certainty-equivalent (single-trajectory forecast) control. The learned policy also exhibits greater robustness on challenging instances, consistently demonstrating better tail-risk characteristics. Analysis of the resulting trees indicates that our method constructs compact, selectively branching structures that capture high-impact events while keeping most trajectories nearly deterministic. These findings highlight that the value of a scenario tree depends critically on the decisions it supports, and provide an effective framework to train scenario tree constructors merely based on the closed-loop control optimization signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向控制的情景树构建方法，通过强化学习直接优化闭环控制利润，而非匹配概率分布。在电池套利问题上，该方法优于传统情景缩减方法和确定性预测控制，并展现出更好的鲁棒性和尾部风险特性。
AI.motivation: 传统情景树构建方法注重匹配概率分布（如Wasserstein距离），但分布精度不一定能转化为更好的控制性能。因此，需要一种直接基于控制性能来优化情景树构建的方法。
AI.method: 固定树拓扑，将情景树构建视为将采样情景分配给叶节点的序贯决策问题。使用基于注意力的策略参数化分配过程，并通过强化学习训练，以闭环控制利润为目标。训练中采用非对称评论家（asymmetric critic）来利用未来真实轨迹的额外信息以稳定训练。
AI.result: 在风险规避的电池套利问题上，所提方法在所有预测集大小下均获得最高利润，优于经典的前向/后向情景缩减方法和确定性等价控制。同时，在困难实例上表现出更好的鲁棒性和尾部风险特性。
AI.conclusion: 情景树的价值取决于其支持的决策，而所提框架能够仅基于闭环控制优化信号有效训练情景树构建器，生成紧凑且选择性分支的树结构，捕捉高影响事件而保持大部分轨迹近似确定。

title: GraphThink: Graph-Enhanced LLM Thinking for Long-Horizon Embodied Task Planning
summary: Embodied agents using LLM-based planners often struggle with physical hallucinations, poor generalization to long-horizon tasks, and lack of environmental awareness. We propose GraphThink, a novel framework that integrates a task graph to provide structured knowledge for robust planning and a scene graph to maintain environmental memory for event-driven replanning. Specifically, the task graph guides LLM thinking through contextual prompting and iterative refinement, effectively mitigating planning hallucinations. Furthermore, within the GRPO framework, the task graph offers delicate reward design to train the LLM planner, enhancing long-horizon planning capabilities and improving generalization. Finally, an event-driven replanning module, powered by the scene graph, enables closed-loop environment awareness and error correction. GraphThink achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ALFRED benchmark. In particular, our high-level planner surpasses leading API-based LLMs on both the validation set and held-out long-horizon tasks, underscoring its robust zero-shot and few-shot capabilities. Additional evaluations further demonstrate strong out-of-distribution generalization to novel tasks and environments.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphThink框架，结合任务图与场景图，通过上下文提示、迭代精炼和GRPO奖励设计缓解幻觉并提升长时程规划能力，在ALFRED基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的具身智能体在物理幻觉、长时程任务泛化及环境感知方面存在不足。
AI.method: GraphThink框架：任务图提供结构化知识指导LLM思考（上下文提示+迭代精炼）；场景图维护环境记忆，支持事件驱动的重规划；在GRPO框架下利用任务图设计奖励以训练LLM规划器。
AI.result: 在ALFRED基准上达到SOTA，高层规划器在验证集和长时程任务上超越领先的API式LLM，并展示出鲁棒的零样本/少样本及分布外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GraphThink通过结构化任务图和场景图有效提升LLM规划器的性能与泛化性，验证了图引导和奖励设计在具身智能规划中的有效性。

title: SG-WAM: Text-Grounded and Spatial-aware Semantic Guidance for World-Action Models
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, most existing WAMs generate future videos and actions by relying mainly on visual cues rather than language instructions, since off-the-shelf text encoders embed instructions independently of visual observations. As a result, the videos predicted by these WAMs are often semantically misaligned with their corresponding language instructions, which degrades the accuracy of the predicted actions. To overcome this limitation, we propose SG-WAM, a semantic guidance method for world-action models that leverages a vision-language model (VLM) as a semantic planner to enhance the instruction-grounding capacity of world-action models. Specifically, we train a VLM-based planner to predict text-grounded and spatial-aware semantic foresight. The text-grounded semantic foresight grounds the instruction by identifying the correct target objects, and the spatial-aware semantic foresight provides the scene geometry for precise manipulation. We then inject this foresight into the world-action model as high-level semantic guidance, ensuring that both future-video generation and action prediction faithfully follow the language instruction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the superiority of our semantic guidance method, showcasing precise manipulation and strong instruction-following capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SG-WAM，利用VLM语义规划器为世界动作模型提供语义引导，增强其指令理解能力，提升视频生成和动作预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型主要依赖视觉信息，忽略语言指令，导致预测视频与指令语义不一致，降低动作精度。
AI.method: 训练基于VLM的规划器生成文本锚定和空间感知的语义前瞻，并将其注入世界动作模型作为高层语义引导。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实实验中，SG-WAM在操作精度和指令跟随能力上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导能有效提升世界动作模型的指令接地能力，实现精确操作。

title: TDMA Based Communications Control Co-Design for Cooperative Carrying: Delay Calibration and Sampling-Rate Optimization
summary: Multi robot teams performing cooperative transportation face a fundamental challenge: maintaining stable control while keeping communications efficient. This paper investigates how adaptive sampling time adjustment informed by measured network delay and strategic leader rotation can distribute wireless load fairly across the team. We use physics based simulation in MuJoCo with realistic wireless modeling, including time division multiple access, medium access control, jitter, queueing, and packet loss, to evaluate three control approaches: fixed sampling with static leadership, dynamic sampling with static leadership, and dynamic sampling with rotating leadership. Our results reveal an important trade off: dynamic sampling effectively reduces communications overhead without compromising control performance, while rotating the leader role meaningfully improves how fairly airtime is distributed all with negligible impact on the team carrying ability. to the best of our knowledge, being among the first to jointly examine dynamic sampling, rotating leadership, and wireless protocol interactions in physicsrealistic multi robot cooperation, this work provides practical guidance for deploying coordinated robotic teams in real world settings where communications resources are limited.

AI.tldr: 本文通过物理仿真研究了多机器人协作运输中自适应采样与领导者轮换对无线负载公平性和控制性能的影响，发现动态采样可降低通信开销，而领导者轮换能提升空口公平性，且对运输能力影响极小。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作运输面临控制稳定性和通信效率之间的根本挑战，现有研究较少同时考虑动态采样、领导者轮换和无线协议交互，因此需要探索在有限通信资源下如何优化控制与通信的平衡。
AI.method: 使用基于MuJoCo的物理仿真，结合真实的无线建模（包括TDMA、MAC、抖动、队列和丢包），对比了固定采样+静态领导、动态采样+静态领导、动态采样+旋转领导三种控制方案。
AI.result: 动态采样有效降低通信开销且不牺牲控制性能；旋转领导显著改善空口时间分配的公平性，但几乎不影响团队运输能力。
AI.conclusion: 动态采样和领导者轮换的结合为真实环境中通信受限的多机器人协作提供了实用指导，该研究是该领域首批综合考察这些因素的工作之一。

title: LibraSpec: Dynamic Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding via Marginal-Gain-Driven Optimization
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens for parallel verification, with efficiency critically determined by the speculative length selected at each decoding round. Existing dynamic speculation methods select the speculation length by estimating how many tokens will be accepted, which is reasonable for autoregressive drafters that generates tokens sequentially. The recent wave of diffusion-based drafters, however, generates candidate blocks in parallel at substantially lower drafting cost, shifting the key question from how many tokens to generate to how many generated tokens are worth verifying. We therefore reformulate dynamic speculative-length selection as expected-speedup optimization and derive a marginal criterion that extends the speculative sequence only when its acceptance gain outweighs the additional verification cost. Building on this criterion, we develop \textit{LibraSpec}, a training-free and plug-and-play algorithm that iteratively determines the speculative length using drafter confidence scores. Theoretically, we prove that LibraSpec monotonically converges toward the optimal speculative length. Experiments across six target models, three diffusion-based speculative decoding methods, and math, coding, and chat benchmarks show consistent improvements under both greedy and sampling settings, achieving a further $0.5\sim1.5\times$ improvement over baselines and up to $8.49\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LibraSpec，一种无需训练、即插即用的动态推测长度选择算法，通过边际准则优化期望加速比，显著提升基于扩散模型的推测解码效率。
AI.motivation: 现有动态推测长度方法基于自回归草稿模型的顺序生成特性，而扩散式草稿模型并行生成候选块，成本更低，因此关键问题不再是生成多少token，而是验证多少token值得。
AI.method: 将动态推测长度选择转化为期望加速优化问题，推导出边际准则：仅当接受增益超过额外验证成本时才扩展推测序列；基于该准则，利用草稿模型置信度分数迭代确定推测长度。
AI.result: 在6种目标模型、3种扩散式推测解码方法及数学、编程、聊天基准上，贪婪和采样设置下均获得一致改进，比基线进一步加速0.5~1.5倍，最高比自回归解码加速8.49倍。
AI.conclusion: LibraSpec理论证明单调收敛于最优推测长度，实验验证其有效性，为扩散式推测解码提供了一种高效的动态长度选择方案。

title: Adaptive Sequential Test Planning for Multi-Mechanism Reliability Qualification via Bayesian Monte Carlo Tree Search
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Reliability
summary: Reliability qualification of advanced semiconductor devices requires sequential stress decisions that balance characterization objectives against multiple competing failure mechanisms. Current practice relies on static test plans derived from population-level acceleration models, which cannot adapt to per-unit variability or real-time degradation observations. This paper presents a closed-loop adaptive test planning framework that formulates reliability qualification as a partially observable sequential decision problem and solves it using Monte Carlo tree search for seed-action simulators (MCTS-SA) coupled with extended Kalman filter (EKF) belief-state estimation. The framework models stochastic, per-device variability in bias temperature instability (BTI), electromigration (EM), and time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), and treats stress selection as a constrained sequential optimization, i.e., to maximize the probability of successful degradation characterization while respecting catastrophic failure constraints. Under the experimental assumptions used here (discrete stress actions, proxy damage observability, and cumulative degradation without recovery), we believe this to be a novel application of tree-search-based adaptive test planning to multi-mechanism reliability qualification. Across 5,000 planning iterations, the characterization yield (CY) improves from 20% in the first 500 iterations to over 54% in the final 500, with 39% cumulative success, while the best successful test sequence terminates with EM and TDDB damage fractions DEM=0.564 and DTDDB=0.537, well within safety margins. These results demonstrate that sequential Bayesian planning can synthesize damage-aware test policies that significantly outperform non-adaptive strategies for reliability qualification under competing failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索和扩展卡尔曼滤波的闭环自适应测试规划框架，用于多失效机制下的半导体器件可靠性鉴定，显著提高了表征成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有可靠性鉴定依赖静态测试计划，无法适应器件个体差异和实时退化观测，导致表征效率低且难以平衡多种竞争失效机制。
AI.method: 将可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测序贯决策问题，采用MCTS-SA进行动作规划，并用EKF估计信念状态，以最大化退化表征成功概率并满足灾难性失效约束。
AI.result: 在5000次规划迭代中，表征良率从20%提升至54%，累计成功率为39%，最优测试序列的EM和TDDB损伤分数均在安全范围内。
AI.conclusion: 序贯贝叶斯规划能生成损伤感知的自适应测试策略，显著优于非自适应方法，适用于竞争失效模式下的可靠性鉴定。

title: SHRIMP: Iterative Refinement of Robot Task Plans
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, The 39th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology (UIST '26)
summary: As collaborative robots have entered domains such as manufacturing, agriculture, and healthcare, programming or adapting robot behavior typically requires robotic expertise that most end users lack. Natural language lowers this barrier. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have made it feasible to translate natural language into robot task plans. However, language-based task specification suffers from semantic ambiguity, and generative models lack transparency for how language instructions become robot actions, making it difficult for users to validate the plan before execution. To address these issues, we introduce SHRIMP, a system that allows users to automatically generate a hierarchical robot primitive plan using natural language and iteratively revise their plan through re-prompting and explicit correction. At each revision, SHRIMP allows users to validate their plan in simulation, and once satisfied, execute it on the physical robot. Through a user study involving participants planning tabletop kitchen tasks (n=35), we validate that SHRIMP improves perceived control and enhances robot transparency. System videos and source code are available at https://wisc-hci.github.io/SHRIMP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHRIMP系统，通过自然语言自动生成层次化机器人原始计划，并支持用户通过重新提示和显式修正迭代修订，在模拟中验证后执行，提高了用户感知控制和机器人透明度。
AI.motivation: 协作机器人进入多个领域，但编程需要专业机器人知识，自然语言可降低门槛。然而，语言规范存在语义模糊，生成模型缺乏透明度，用户难以在执行前验证计划。
AI.method: SHRIMP系统结合LLM将自然语言转换为层次化机器人原始计划，支持用户通过重新提示和显式修正迭代修订，并在模拟环境中验证计划，最终在实体机器人上执行。
AI.result: 用户研究（n=35）表明SHRIMP改善了用户感知控制并增强了机器人透明度。
AI.conclusion: SHRIMP有效解决了自然语言任务规划的语义模糊和透明度问题，提升了用户对机器人计划的控制感和信任感。

title: Rethinking 3D Segmentation from Individual LiDAR Scans: Incidence-Aware Sampling on the SIP Benchmark
summary: 3D scene understanding is increasingly important in construction, yet most methods are developed on curated datasets that do not fully reflect real site sensing conditions. In many workflows, individual LiDAR scans provide rapid local updates rather than complete scene representations, producing limited surface coverage, acquisition-driven density variation, and severe imbalance between dominant planar surfaces and sparse construction elements. Because large point clouds must be downsampled, sampling resolution and point allocation directly affect the balance between geometric detail and spatial context. This study evaluates these effects under a fixed per-fragment point budget and introduces an incidence-aware sampling strategy for individual LiDAR scans. The method maps points to a geometry-normalized manifold space for voxel-based selection while preserving original Euclidean coordinates for downstream learning. It requires only point coordinates and normals and no backbone modification. Using the Site in Pieces (SIP) benchmark, experiments with Point Transformer and PointNeXt show improved resolution-averaged segmentation performance, especially for non-planar elements and ladders, while reducing sensitivity to sampling resolution. The results show that acquisition-aware sampling can provide a more stable geometric representation and should be treated as an active component of individual-scan 3D segmentation rather than generic preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对单次LiDAR扫描的入射感知采样方法，在固定点预算下改善3D分割性能，尤其是对非平面元素和爬梯，同时减少对采样分辨率的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解方法多基于完整场景的整理数据集，而实际工作流中单次LiDAR扫描存在覆盖有限、密度不均和类别不平衡问题，且下采样会显著影响几何细节与空间上下文的平衡。
AI.method: 将点映射到几何归一化流形空间进行体素选择，保留原始欧氏坐标用于下游学习；仅需点坐标和法线，无需修改骨干网络。
AI.result: 在SIP基准上，搭配Point Transformer和PointNeXt，平均分割性能提升，尤其对非平面元素和爬梯，且对采样分辨率的敏感性降低。
AI.conclusion: 采集感知的采样应视为单扫描3D分割的主动组件，而非通用预处理，能提供更稳定的几何表示。

title: Can We Optimize the Performance-Carbon Emission Break-Even Point?: The Quest for Greener LLMs
comment: 13 Pages, 6 Figures, Submitted to ARR Cycle
summary: The carbon footprint of any deployed Large Language Model (LLM) accumulates during inference, where repeated use of the model substantially exceeds the one-time cost of fine-tuning. Yet most efficiency interventions target either pre-training scale or post-hoc compression. We ask whether folding a calibrated, differentiable energy surrogate into the fine-tuning objective can produce inference behavior that gains task accuracy at zero or near-zero carbon cost, a break-even configuration. We propose a joint loss mechanism with a per-model carbon-emission parameter, a linear surrogate over parameter norm, FLOP proxy, and a memory proxy, fit from on-hardware energy profiling. We fine-tune three architecturally distinct families: Gemma-2 2B, Llama-3.1 8B, and Qwen-2.5 14B, and evaluate inference F1 and CO$_2$ emissions on three MMLU subjects: abstract algebra, philosophy, and formal logic. We discover from several outcomes that the carbon term behaves as either harmful interference or beneficial regularization depending on the task structure. We position calibrated carbon-aware fine-tuning as a lightweight, drop-in regularizer with a non-empty but model and task-dependent break-even region. This is an ongoing work, and we will release our codebase soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将校准的、可微分的能源代理纳入微调目标的联合损失机制，以在零或近零碳成本下提升推理任务准确性。实验发现，碳项的行为取决于任务结构，既可能是有害干扰，也可能是有益正则化。
AI.motivation: LLM推理阶段的碳排放远超训练，但现有效率干预多聚焦于预训练规模或后处理压缩，缺乏对推理阶段碳成本的直接优化。
AI.method: 构建包含碳发射参数的联合损失，使用参数范数、FLOP代理和内存代理的线性代理模型拟合硬件能耗数据，对三种模型家族进行微调，评估MMLU子集的F1和CO2排放。
AI.result: 碳项在不同任务上表现出双重效果：或作为有害干扰，或作为有益正则化，存在任务相关的盈亏平衡区域。
AI.conclusion: 校准的碳感知微调可作为轻量级、即插即用的正则化器，但其适用性依赖于模型和任务，且存在一定盈亏平衡区间。

title: When Is Benchmark Contamination Detectable? Information Limits and Power-Calibrated Audits
summary: Behavioral contamination detectors can return "no evidence" either because a benchmark is clean or because the audit has little power. We formalize this distinction for a benchmark in which an unknown fraction alpha of items was seen during training. With matched clean and seen controls, the behavioral channel is the sparse mixture Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1, and an exact second-moment argument shows that detectability is governed by alpha * rho * sqrt(m), where rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) measures behavioral separability. Any scalar detector reduces to its efficacy, ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho, which can be estimated from controls before the audit is run. A separate sample-split certificate lower-bounds alpha distribution-free, without requiring an orientation assumption. Our empirical finding is two-sided. Frozen calibration efficacy predicts held-out power curves, with R^2 = 0.83-0.98 across six exact-permutation channels, but the efficacy-only Gaussian budget is miscalibrated at the small sample sizes it prescribes, failing in 9/9 gate-passing channels even though efficacy itself transports. The failure is in the inversion, not the calibration. A predeclared two-stage planner that simulates the deployed test repairs the budgets, is uniformly conservative, and abstains when its probe does not transport. The certificate is valid but vacuous at audit scale, and a five-seed paired injection study recovers the mechanism ordering verbatim > paraphrase > surface, in which the apparent answer-only signal is explained by baseline drift. We report the audit contract and its failures together: a non-rejection is interpretable only alongside the efficacy, budget, and validity gates that produced it.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了行为污染检测中'无证据'的两种含义，提出基于第二矩的检测框架，并发现功效校准在小样本下失效，但通过预声明的两阶段规划器可修复。
AI.motivation: 行为污染检测器返回'无证据'可能因为基准干净，也可能因为审计功效不足，现有方法无法区分这两种情况，需要形式化这一区别。
AI.method: 利用匹配的干净和已见控制组构建稀疏混合模型，通过第二矩论证推导检测可检测性由 alpha * rho * sqrt(m) 决定，引入功效函数并进行样本分割证书，同时提出预声明的两阶段规划器模拟部署测试。
AI.result: 冻结校准功效预测保留功效曲线（R^2=0.83-0.98），但功效高斯预算在小样本下失准（9/9失败）；两阶段规划器修复预算且保守；证书有效但空洞；机制排序为逐字>释义>表面。
AI.conclusion: 非拒绝结果必须结合功效、预算和有效性门槛共同解释；功效传输可靠但预算校准需谨慎，预声明规划器可提供稳健审计。

title: XClipGS: Exact Half-Space Clipping for Medical Volume Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian-splatting proxies enable interactive rendering of volumetric medical scans, but a clipping plane exposes anatomy not constrained by external-view training and intersects primitives that conventional splatting can only keep or drop whole. We present XClipGS (eXact Clipping), which treats these as two separate problems: the render-time clip operator and supervision of the hidden interior. Under the local affine model used by EWA splatting, the ray integral of a half-space-restricted Gaussian factorizes exactly into its ordinary 2D footprint and a conditional Gaussian CDF whose argument is affine in pixel coordinates. The resulting closed-form per-pixel operator introduces no learned clipping parameters or auxiliary network and remains differentiable with respect to the primitive and plane. We use multi-distance reference views with varied clipping-plane axes and offsets to supervise the interior through the same operator. We also introduce a paired clipped/unclipped cut-face protocol with difference-referenced cut error (CDE) and culled-side leakage (Leak), because global image metrics dilute errors near the plane. On eight CT and MRI volumes with plane offsets not used for training, XClipGS attains the highest PSNR on every volume (33.56 versus 32.34 dB for ClipGS) while rendering at over 650 FPS, far above real time, versus 278 FPS. On voxel-axis cut-face views, it raises average band SSIM from 0.809 to 0.860 and leaks roughly 40 times less. Without retraining, it also achieves the best average across all four metrics on arbitrary-normal planes; on a fixed interior, it matches RaRa's face fidelity with about 16 times less leakage. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/XClipGS/

AI.tldr: 提出XClipGS，利用高斯样条在EWA模型下的精确裁剪算子，实现医学体积数据渲染中裁剪面的准确表达，并通过参考视图监督内部结构，在速度和精度上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯样条方法在裁剪时无法处理被平面切割的基元，且外部视图训练无法约束内部解剖结构，导致裁剪面附近出现伪影。
AI.method: 基于EWA样条，推导半空间限制高斯的光线积分闭合解，得到像素级裁剪算子（无学习参数），并用多距离参考视图监督内部；引入配对裁剪/未裁剪协议和差参考误差（CDE, Leak）评估。
AI.result: 在8个CT/MRI体数据上，XClipGS平均PSNR最高（33.56 vs 32.34 dB），渲染>650 FPS（优于278 FPS）；轴对齐切面平均带SSIM从0.809提升至0.860，泄漏减少约40倍；任意法向平面上平均优于其他方法，固定内部时泄漏减少约16倍。
AI.conclusion: XClipGS提供了精确、高效的裁剪算子，显著提升裁剪平面附近的重建质量，且无需额外训练参数或网络，有望推动医学可视化交互应用。

title: TongGuOCR: A Layout-Aware and Token-Augmented OCR Framework for Chinese Historical Documents
summary: Chinese historical documents preserve valuable cultural heritage, but many collections remain accessible only as scanned page images, preventing full-text retrieval, collation, and computational analysis. Optical character recognition (OCR) can bridge this gap, but accurate transcription remains challenging because historical documents often contain complex layouts, rare characters, and nontrivial reading orders. We propose TongGuOCR, a layout-aware and token-augmented OCR framework for Chinese historical documents. First, a Layout-Aware Preprocessing module constructs and refines locally coherent recognition blocks to preserve local context while reducing interference across regions. Second, a Token-Augmented Recognition module augments the transcription target at two complementary levels: character-level vocabulary expansion gives each rare glyph a direct one-token representation and shortens its decoding path, while line-to-line transition modeling injects discrete spatial displacement tokens that guide the decoder along complex reading paths without requiring precise coordinates. Experiments on two Chinese historical document OCR benchmarks show that TongGuOCR outperforms representative traditional task-specific OCR models, general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and OCR-oriented MLLMs. On the more challenging M5HisDoc benchmark, TongGuOCR achieves 93.76 AR and reduces NED from 10.43 to 6.15 and RO-ED from 7.53 to 3.49 relative to the best competing score for each metric. An online demo is available at https://jzzh2004.github.io/TongGuOCR.

AI.tldr: 提出TongGuOCR，一种用于中文历史文档的布局感知与令牌增强OCR框架，通过布局感知预处理和令牌增强识别（字符级词汇扩展与行间位移令牌建模），在复杂版面与罕见字场景下显著提升识别精度，并在M5HisDoc基准上刷新最佳成绩。
AI.motivation: 中文历史文档价值高，但多以扫描图像存在，难以全文检索和计算分析。现有OCR方法在处理复杂版面、罕见字符和非线性阅读顺序时准确率不足，因此需更有效的识别框架。
AI.method: TongGuOCR包含两个核心模块：1) 布局感知预处理，构建并优化局部一致的识别块，保留上下文并减少区域间干扰；2) 令牌增强识别，在字符级别扩展词汇表为罕见字形分配单一令牌缩短解码路径，并在行间转换中注入离散空间位移令牌，引导解码器沿复杂阅读路径识别，无需精确坐标。
AI.result: 在两个中文历史文档OCR基准上，TongGuOCR超越传统OCR、通用多模态大模型及OCR专用多模态大模型。在M5HisDoc上，AR达93.76，NED从10.43降至6.15，RO-ED从7.53降至3.49，均优于最佳对比方法。
AI.conclusion: TongGuOCR通过布局感知与令牌增强有效改善中文历史文档OCR，尤其在处理复杂版面与罕见字方面表现优越，为历史文献数字化提供实用工具。

title: WRAP: Wasserstein-Robust Adaptive Plug-in for Robot Localization
summary: Robotic localization under changing sensing conditions can suffer from biased errors and miscalibrated covariances. We present WRAP, an adapter-agnostic Wasserstein-robust plug-in for nonlinear extended Kalman filter (EKF) and error-state Kalman filter (ESKF) stacks. A causal module supplies time-varying effective process and measurement statistics; a mean-preserving Wasserstein local update then computes least-favorable covariances and a robust gain without changing the propagation model, residual, or retraction. This separates mean adaptation from covariance robustification and uses distinct radii for propagation and sensing. On 18 UWB--IMU sequences held out from adapter training, adapter-only and WRAP reduce mean 3-D position RMSE by $19.8\%$ and $27.4\%$ relative to the nominal ESKF; an isotropic ablation reaches $19.5\%$, linking the incremental gain to directional process-covariance redistribution. An in-sample GNSS--INS study shows that mean adaptation provides most of the accuracy gain, while DR improves consistency and mitigates over-tightened classical covariance estimates. The robust solve takes 0.05 ms for UWB and 2.92 ms for GNSS on a Jetson Orin Nano.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WRAP，一种适配器无关的Wasserstein鲁棒插件，用于非线性EKF和ESKF堆栈，通过因果模块提供时变统计量，并采用均值保持的Wasserstein局部更新计算最不利协方差和鲁棒增益，在不改变传播模型、残差或回缩的情况下，分离均值适应与协方差鲁棒化。实验表明，在UWB-IMU和GNSS-INS数据集上，WRAP显著降低了定位RMSE，提高了一致性，且计算开销低。
AI.motivation: 机器人定位在传感条件变化时，常因偏差和协方差校准不良导致性能下降。现有方法未能同时处理均值偏差和协方差鲁棒性，且缺乏适配器无关的通用解决方案。
AI.method: WRAP包含两个部分：一是因果模块，用于估计时变的有效过程统计量和测量统计量；二是均值保持的Wasserstein局部更新，计算最不利协方差并生成鲁棒增益，同时保持均值不变，并分别使用传播和传感的不同半径。
AI.result: 在18个UWB-IMU序列上，适配器仅和WRAP分别将3D位置RMSE降低19.8%和27.4%；各向同性消融达到19.5%，表明增益来自方向性过程协方差重分配。在GNSS-INS研究中，均值适应贡献主要精度提升，DR改善一致性并缓解过度收紧的经典协方差。鲁棒求解在Jetson Orin Nano上耗时0.05ms（UWB）和2.92ms（GNSS）。
AI.conclusion: WRAP有效提升滤波定位精度和一致性，且计算高效，适用于多种传感器场景。分离均值适应和协方差鲁棒化是关键设计，方向性协方差重分配带来额外收益。

title: Estimation of Spacecraft Inertia Tensor Using Attitude-Only Data from Torque-Free Motion
summary: We present an attitude-only framework for estimating a spacecraft's normalized inertia tensor from torque-free rotational motion. Our method supports both continuous single-arc observations and the joint use of multiple short torque-free arcs, while requiring neither gyroscope measurements nor known control torques. A Karush-Kuhn-Tucker formulation provides a fast linear initialization, which is refined by nonlinear shooting using the exact Jacobi-elliptic solution of Euler's equations and a Magnus-expansion quaternion map. Under controlled attitude noise, tests using a single 500-second arc reduced inertia-tensor error by approximately one order of magnitude relative to an Extended Kalman Filter initialized from the same estimate, while requiring nearly two orders of magnitude less computation. Joint estimation from three 100-second arcs provided a similar improvement in accuracy and remained more than one order of magnitude faster. Photorealistic proximity-operations simulations further evaluated both strategies using monocular image-derived attitudes. The 2000-second single-arc cases achieved sub-thousandth median inertia-tensor error and supported 10-hour attitude predictions with single-digit-degree median error. In three-arc cases using 30-300 seconds per arc, our method consistently outperformed the EKF refinement, with performance governed by rotational excitation and temporal sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅依赖姿态的框架，用于从无外力矩旋转运动中估计航天器的归一化惯性张量，支持单弧段和多短弧段联合估计，无需陀螺仪或已知控制力矩。
AI.motivation: 传统的惯性张量估计通常需要陀螺仪或已知控制力矩，且计算成本高。本文旨在开发一种更高效、更鲁棒的方法，仅利用姿态数据即可实现高精度估计，以简化航天器在轨辨识流程。
AI.method: 采用Karush-Kuhn-Tucker条件进行线性初始化，再通过基于Jacobi椭圆精确解的欧拉方程非线性打靶法和Magnus展开四元数映射进行精细优化。
AI.result: 在单弧段500秒测试中，相对扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），惯性张量误差降低约一个数量级，计算量减少近两个数量级。三弧段100秒联合估计精度类似，且速度仍快一个数量级以上。在真实感近距操作仿真中，2000秒单弧段实现亚千分之一的中位误差，并支持10小时姿态预测（中位误差个位数度）。三弧段（每段30-300秒）也一致优于EKF，性能受旋转激励和时间采样影响。
AI.conclusion: 所提姿态仅用惯性张量估计方法在精度和计算效率上均显著优于EKF，且适用于多弧段场景，为航天器在轨自主辨识提供了有效方案。

title: Multilingual Emotion Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Emotion is central to human communication, and its expression varies across languages. Large audio-language models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on multilingual speech tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they encode emotion through language-specific correlations or language-agnostic representations. We present the first neuron-level interpretability study of this question. We define Multilingual Emotion Neurons (MLENs) as functional units exhibiting stable emotional selectivity and aligned causal effects across languages, and introduce Consistency-Regularized Fusion (CR-Fusion) to identify them. Across four modern LALMs and 12 typologically diverse languages, emotion-sensitive neurons identified independently per language show minimal overlap, and additional monolingual identification data saturates quickly without isolating more transferable units, motivating identification from pooled cross-lingual evidence. Causal interventions demonstrate that MLENs identified by CR-Fusion provide more precise and transferable affective control than monolingual neuron sets in both zero-shot and low-resource settings. Leave-one-out ablations further reveal asymmetric transfer: individual identification languages, including low-resource ones, contribute non-redundant evidence, while several low-resource languages benefit most from the resulting cross-lingual transfer. Together, our findings provide the first causal, neuron-level account of how LALMs encode emotion across languages, and establish multilingual neuron identification as an effective mechanism for understanding cross-lingual affective behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在神经元层面研究多语言音频语言模型（LALMs）如何跨语言编码情感，发现不同语言的情感敏感神经元重叠极少，并提出一致性正则化融合（CR-Fusion）方法来识别多语言情感神经元（MLENs），这些神经元在跨语言情感控制中表现出更精确和可转移的效果，且低资源语言从中获益最多。
AI.motivation: 现有LALMs在多语言语音任务上表现优异，但其情感编码机制是否依赖语言特定关联或语言无关表示尚不清楚，理解这一机制对跨语言情感理解和可控生成至关重要。
AI.method: 定义多语言情感神经元（MLENs）为跨语言具有稳定情感选择性和一致因果效应的功能单元，提出一致性正则化融合（CR-Fusion）来识别这些神经元，并在四种现代LALMs和12种语言上进行验证。通过因果干预和留一法消融评估其迁移效果。
AI.result: 发现独立识别的情感神经元在不同语言间重叠极小，单语识别数据饱和快而无法提取更多可迁移单元；CR-Fusion识别的MLENs在零样本和低资源场景下提供更精确和可转移的情感控制；留一法显示低资源语言贡献非冗余证据，且从跨语言迁移中获益最大。
AI.conclusion: LALMs通过语言无关的多语言情感神经元编码情感，但需要跨语言证据联合识别；CR-Fusion提供了一种有效机制，促进跨语言情感理解的公平性和可控性，尤其惠及低资源语言。

title: DINO-3DRA: Leveraging 2D Foundation Model Semantics for 3D Cerebral Aneurysm Segmentation
summary: Accurate aneurysm segmentation in 3D rotational angiography (3DRA) is hindered by extreme class imbalance, morphological similarity to vessels, and absent large-scale 3D pretraining. 2D vision foundation models encode dense structural priors from 1.7 billion images, yet naïve slice-wise transfer fragments anatomical continuity and destabilises optimisation. We propose DINO-3DRA, a dual-path framework achieving effective cross-dimensional semantic transfer by injecting frozen DINOv3 features into a 3D U-Net backbone via Room-Lite spatial mixing and calibrated residual fusion. On multi-centre 3DRA data, DINO-3DRA achieves state-of-the-art aneurysm segmentation (Dice: 0.758; HD95: 2.75 mm; +13% over nnU-Net) with only 5.72M trainable parameters. Ablation studies confirm that gains arise from structured cross-dimensional transfer rather than loss design alone, with bridged foundation features improving anatomical continuity between aneurysms and parent vessels. Without fine-tuning on CADA and SHINY-ICARUS, DINO-3DRA eliminates all catastrophic failure cases observed in baseline architectures, demonstrating robust generalisation across heterogeneous imaging protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出DINO-3DRA双路径框架，将冻结的DINOv3二维特征通过Room-Lite空间混合与校准残差融合注入3D U-Net，实现跨维度语义迁移，在3DRA动脉瘤分割上达到SOTA（Dice 0.758），仅5.72M参数，并消除基线中的灾难性失败。
AI.motivation: 3DRA动脉瘤分割受类别不平衡、形态相似及缺乏3D预训练限制；2D基础模型虽有强大先验，但逐切片迁移破坏解剖连续性且优化不稳定。
AI.method: 采用双路径架构：冻结DINOv3提取2D特征，经Room-Lite空间混合与校准残差融合注入3D U-Net主干，实现跨维度语义迁移。
AI.result: 多中心数据上Dice 0.758、HD95 2.75mm，较nnU-Net提升13%；仅5.72M可训练参数；无需微调即消除CADA和SHINY-ICARUS上的所有灾难性失败。
AI.conclusion: 结构化跨维度迁移优于单纯损失设计，桥接基础特征增强动脉瘤与母血管的解剖连续性，且跨异构协议泛化鲁棒。

title: ZhuLong: Execution-Grounded LLM Agent for EDA Scripting with Offline API Self-Exploration
summary:
EDA scripting with tool-specific, often undocumented APIs remains a long-tail bottleneck that existing LLMs fail to address. This paper presents ZhuLong, an execution-grounded LLM coding agent for PyAether and SKILL that combines API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools, augmented by an offline API self-exploration mechanism that infers undocumented API behaviors through counterfactual experimentation.
  We evaluate ZhuLong on EDA-Eval-PyAether, a benchmark of 158 real-world tasks with assertion-based execution, where the complete system achieves 78.5% Pass@1 in the commercial Empyrean Aether environment, substantially outperforming a pure LLM baseline (23.6%). Ablation studies identify sandbox execution as the dominant performance driver (41.2 pp drop when removed), with the self-exploration mechanism contributing an additional 3.2 pp accuracy gain and a 22.1% reduction in per-task tool calls. On 20 interactive tasks involving unsaved layouts and schematics, ZhuLong achieves 60.0% Pass@1 for PyAether and 50.0% for SKILL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZhuLong，一个基于执行 grounds 的LLM编码代理，用于PyAether和SKILL，通过MCP工具集成API检索、文档检查和沙箱执行，并利用离线API自我探索机制推断未文档化API行为，在EDA任务上显著优于纯LLM基线。
AI.motivation: EDA脚本编写依赖工具特定的未文档化API，现有LLM无法有效处理，成为长期瓶颈，需要专门的代理系统来解决。
AI.method: ZhuLong结合统一MCP工具进行API检索、文档检查和沙箱执行，并引入离线API自我探索机制，通过反事实实验推断未文档化API行为。
AI.result: 在EDA-Eval-PyAether基准上，完整系统Pass@1达78.5%，远超纯LLM基线（23.6%）；消融实验显示沙箱执行贡献最大（移除后下降41.2个百分点），自我探索机制带来3.2个百分点准确率提升和22.1%工具调用减少；交互任务上PyAether和SKILL分别达60.0%和50.0%。
AI.conclusion: 执行 grounded 的代理和API自我探索能有效解决EDA脚本中的未文档化API问题，显著提升LLM在真实任务中的表现。

title: OmnilingualGAIA2: Evaluating the Multilingual Gap in Frontier AI Agents
summary: Agentic benchmarks aim to measure how well AI agents plan, search, execute, and recover within realistic multi-tool environments, but they are almost exclusively in English. As AI agents are globally deployed to a linguistically diverse user base, whether agentic competence measured in English transfers to other languages remains an open question. We introduce OmnilingualGAIA2, a machine-translated expansion (with partial human- expert validation) of the GAIA2 agentic benchmark, covering ten target languages spanning five writing systems, paired with a localised and human-calibrated multilingual verifier. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight agents, we find a universal cross-lingual gap of 8.8-18.4 pass@3 points that is agent-asymmetric in magnitude, concentrates on tool-orchestration rather than quantitative reasoning, and does not close with model scale. A stratified error attribution decomposes the gap as predominantly model-driven (55%), with a bounded translation-contamination floor of only 6.4% of scenario-language pairs. Human-expert linguistic analysis further identifies morphological cue loss and amplified ambiguity as the primary failure mechanisms in non-Latin-script languages. Our results argue that multilingual agentic evaluation must become a standard part of the reporting protocol for globally deployed agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OmnilingualGAIA2，一个多语言智能体基准测试，并发现英语能力并不能完全迁移到其他语言，存在普遍且不对称的跨语言性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试几乎全为英语，而AI智能体面向全球多语言用户，因此需要评估英语能力是否迁移至其他语言。
AI.method: 通过机器翻译（部分人工专家验证）扩展GAIA2基准，覆盖10种语言、5种文字系统，并配备本地化和人工校准的多语言验证器；对7个前沿和开源智能体进行测试，并进行分层错误归因和人类专家语言分析。
AI.result: 发现所有智能体存在8.8-18.4 pass@3的跨语言差距，该差距与模型规模无关，主要源于工具编排而非定量推理；错误归因显示55%由模型能力驱动，翻译污染仅占6.4%；非拉丁文字中形态线索丢失和歧义放大是主要失败机制。
AI.conclusion: 多语言智能体评估应成为全球部署智能体报告的标准部分。

title: SeqLoc: Beyond the Single Frame for Cross-View Geo-Localization in Feature-Sparse Scenes
summary: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) with OpenStreetMap (OSM) performs well in structure-rich urban environments but collapses in feature-sparse scenes such as rural roads. To study this failure mode, in this work, we introduce CV-FSS, a benchmark that pairs sequential panoramas from five rural regions with aligned OSM maps, on which single-frame methods degrade drastically. We then propose SeqLoc, an online test-time sequence aggregation mechanism that recursively maintains a log-belief volume with three key components: (1) Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty (ETU) tempers each incoming pose likelihood volume by its normalized entropy; (2) Map-Guided Relocalization (MGR) mixes a map-shaped recovery distribution into the belief so that a suppressed true pose can recover; (3) Peak-Anchored Smoothing (PAS) derives the final pose at sub-grid precision. Extensive experiments on CV-FSS and CV-RHO demonstrate that SeqLoc outperforms single-frame localization by a large margin, improving both position and orientation recall by over 50%. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CV-FSS基准和SeqLoc方法，解决跨视角地理定位在特征稀疏场景（如乡村道路）失效的问题，通过在线测试时序列聚合大幅提升定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视角地理定位方法在结构丰富的城市环境中表现良好，但在特征稀疏的乡村场景中性能急剧下降，缺乏针对该场景的基准和有效解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SeqLoc，一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，包含三个关键组件：熵温和不确定性（ETU）、地图引导重定位（MGR）和峰值锚定平滑（PAS），递归维护对数置信体积。
AI.result: 在CV-FSS和CV-RHO基准上，SeqLoc相比单帧定位在位置和朝向召回率上均提升超过50%。
AI.conclusion: SeqLoc有效解决了特征稀疏场景下的跨视角地理定位问题，显著优于单帧方法，并开源基准和代码。

title: Personalized Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance via Preference-based Bayesian Optimization
summary: A significant challenge in exoskeleton robotics is the need to dynamically adapt control profiles to individual motion preferences, thereby ensuring both efficient and comfortable assistance. Currently, since user experience can serve as a comprehensive metric for evaluating the effectiveness of assistance, user preference-based optimization methods have been widely studied for parameter tuning. However, the existing methods rely heavily on extensive human-robot online interactions and suffer from slow optimization speed, which not only induces user fatigue but also compromises optimization effectiveness. Therefore, this paper aims to explore an efficient preference-based optimization framework for personalized exoskeleton assistance that can learn optimal parameters with minimal interaction. We propose a preference-based Bayesian optimization (PbBO) approach that can improve sample efficiency by leveraging knowledge about the sampling distribution of candidate sets. For optimizing six control parameters, PbBO can converge to user-preferred parameters with 90.7% validation accuracy via 20 iterations. Moreover, the hierarchical controller is designed to generate personalized torque for different tasks and achieve interaction torque tracking in real time. The results of treadmill and outdoor experiments demonstrate that the optimized parameters can reduce metabolic rate by 14.5%-15.4%, heart rate by 6.3%-7.6%, and muscle activation by 6.7%-31.5% compared to unassisted walking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于偏好的贝叶斯优化框架(PbBO)，用于高效个性化外骨骼辅助参数优化，仅需20次迭代即可达到90.7%的验证准确率，并在 treadmill 和户外实验中显著降低代谢率、心率和肌肉激活。
AI.motivation: 现有基于用户偏好的外骨骼参数优化方法依赖大量人机在线交互，优化速度慢，导致用户疲劳并影响优化效果，因此需要一种更高效的个性化辅助优化方法。
AI.method: 提出偏好贝叶斯优化(PbBO)，利用候选集采样分布知识提高样本效率；设计分层控制器在不同任务中实时生成个性化扭矩并实现交互扭矩跟踪。
AI.result: PbBO在20次迭代内收敛到用户偏好参数，验证准确率90.7%；实验表明优化后代谢率降低14.5%-15.4%，心率降低6.3%-7.6%，肌肉激活降低6.7%-31.5%。
AI.conclusion: PbBO能高效优化外骨骼控制参数，减少交互次数，同时提升辅助效果，为个性化外骨骼辅助提供了可行方案。

title: REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are prone to hallucination, which undermines their reliability and poses challenges for safe deployment. Hallucinations in LRMs arise from two distinct failure sources: reasoning hallucination, where flawed inference steps propagate to an incorrect conclusion, and knowledge hallucination, where the model lacks the requisite factual knowledge to answer the query. To address reasoning hallucination, we propose REIN, an alignment framework that trains LRMs to produce a structured reasoning sequence, $\texttt{<think>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<reflection>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<answer>}$, enabling explicit self-reflection before committing to a final answer. To address knowledge hallucination, REIN introduces a reward mechanism that encourages explicit abstention (e.g., "I don't know") when none of the sampled reasoning chains yields a correct answer, allowing the model to refrain from unsupported predictions. Extensive evaluations on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that REIN consistently improves selective accuracy, reduces incorrect-but-self-endorsed responses, and maintains high coverage compared with competitive baselines. Notably, REIN achieves these gains within a single forward pass, without requiring process supervision, inference-time controllers, external search, or multi-round critiques. Experiments on multiple backbones show that REIN reduces the hallucination proxy by $58\sim72\%$ relative to the base models while maintaining $86\sim91\%$ average coverage, and improves selective accuracy on attempted questions by $6.6\sim14.2\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出REIN对齐框架，通过结构化推理序列和显式弃答机制，减少大型推理模型的推理幻觉和知识幻觉，在保持高覆盖率的同时显著提升选择性准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型易产生幻觉，影响可靠性和安全部署，且幻觉源于推理错误和知识缺失两种不同原因，现有方法缺乏针对性的对齐方案。
AI.method: REIN框架：训练模型生成<think>→<reflection>→<answer>的结构化推理序列，实现显式自我反思；并通过奖励机制鼓励在无法正确回答时明确弃答（如“我不知道”），避免无依据预测。
AI.result: 在数学和常识推理基准上，REIN将幻觉代理指标相对降低58%~72%，平均覆盖率保持在86%~91%，选择性准确率提升6.6%~14.2%，且无需过程监督或外部搜索。
AI.conclusion: REIN能有效减少两类幻觉，提高模型可靠性和选择性预测能力，且推理高效，适合实际部署。

title: IRPol-Fuse: Energy-structure coordination for infrared polarization fusion under low visibility
summary: Robust perception under low-visibility conditions requires fused imagery that jointly preserves infrared thermal saliency and polarization-derived structural details. However, existing infrared-polarization image fusion (IPIF) methods often overemphasize dominant infrared responses, causing weak yet informative polarization textures in dark regions to be suppressed. To address this issue, we propose IRPol-Fuse, an energy-structure coordinated IPIF framework for challenging low-visibility scenarios. The proposed framework contains three key modules: Polarization Attention Fusion for adaptive infrared-polarization allocation, Infrared Highlight Injector for highlight-guided infrared preservation, and Polarization Texture Injector for polarization texture restoration and fine-detail recovery. We further construct LI-PI, a dedicated infrared-polarization evaluation dataset for low-visibility and visually concealed scenes. Experiments on LI-PI and the public LDDRS dataset demonstrate that IRPol-Fuse achieves favorable performance in thermal target preservation, structural detail recovery, and visual naturalness. Region-aware evaluation and downstream object detection further verify that the proposed energy-structure coordination strategy effectively preserves both infrared target saliency and polarization-derived structural information. Code is available at https://github.com/1hzf/IRPolar-Fuse .

AI.tldr: 提出IRPol-Fuse框架，通过能量-结构协调策略融合红外与偏振图像，在低能见度下同时保留热目标显著性和偏振结构细节，并构建了LI-PI数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有红外-偏振融合方法过度强调红外响应，导致暗区中弱偏振纹理被抑制，影响低能见度下的感知质量。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：偏振注意力融合、红外高光注入器和偏振纹理注入器，并构建低能见度评估数据集LI-PI。
AI.result: 在LI-PI和LDDRS数据集上，IRPol-Fuse在热目标保留、结构细节恢复和视觉自然度上表现优越，区域评估和下游目标检测验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 能量-结构协调策略能有效融合红外显著性和偏振结构信息，适用于低能见度场景。

title: Unsure but Certain: Uncovering the Representation-Confidence Gap in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models use broad context to create text, suggesting they might handle input noise better than standard models. Testing reveals this is only partially true. Internally, diffusion models detect text errors highly accurately. Externally, their reported certainty ignores this signal. As accuracy drops due to noise, confidence stays near its maximum and the ability to correctly rank answers degrades toward random chance. We call this mismatch the representation confidence gap. The visible concentration of high certainty scores is a misleading surface symptom. Standard math adjustments remove this concentration but fail to fix the underlying loss of ranking order. This ranking deficit favors standard models under noisy conditions and resists common remedies. Matching training recovers accuracy but not ranking, while score recalibration and input level error signals cannot reorder the final answers. However, the information needed to properly evaluate an answer survives in the hidden states. A lightweight extraction tool uses this signal to improve ranking. This approach is highly efficient because it leaves the base model completely frozen and requires zero additional text generation steps. We present this tool to prove the signal exists, while clearly noting its limits. Ultimately, certainty reliability is a more pressing limit than overall accuracy under noisy conditions.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型在内部能准确检测文本错误，但外部置信度却忽略该信号，导致噪声下置信度虚高且排序能力退化，即“表示-置信度差距”。标准调整无法修复排序缺陷，但隐藏状态中保留的可评估信息可被轻量提取工具利用，以零额外生成步骤改善排序。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型利用广泛上下文生成文本，可能比标准模型更鲁棒地应对输入噪声，但需实证检验其内部错误检测与外部置信度是否一致。
AI.method: 对比扩散模型与标准模型在噪声输入下的准确率与置信度；分析内部表示与外部输出的差异；尝试数学重校准、训练匹配、输入级错误信号等修复方法；设计轻量提取工具从隐藏状态中解码评估信号以改进排序。
AI.result: 扩散模型内部错误检测准确，但外部置信度虚高，排序能力退化至随机水平；标准数学调整无法恢复排序；轻量提取工具利用隐藏状态信号可改善排序，且不改变基础模型或增加生成步骤。
AI.conclusion: 噪声下置信度可靠性比总体准确率更关键；表示与置信度之间的差距是核心限制，隐藏状态中存在可提取的评估信号，但该工具仅证明信号存在，仍有局限。

title: Latent World Models with Monotone Planning Costs for Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Image-goal navigation with latent world models requires not only accurate future prediction, but also a planning cost that reliably ranks candidate action sequences. We define the cost as the cosine distance between the predicted future embedding and the goal embedding, and show that poor cost ordering can mislead sampling-based planners such as Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). To address this, we propose a latent world model built on a frozen DINO-family encoder and train it with two complementary objectives. An autoregressive rollout loss reduces the gap between training and multi-step planning rollouts, while a Monotone Cost Ranking (MCR) loss directly encourages increasingly perturbed action sequences to receive higher planning costs. We also study InfoNCE-based action-contrastive training and find that temporal permutation negatives distort the latent geometry and degrade planning performance. On the GNM navigation dataset, our method outperforms Navigation World Models (NWM), DINO-WM, OmniVLA, and NoMaD, achieving state-of-the-art image-goal navigation performance while reducing orientation error by $2.7\times$ over the same-encoder DINO WM baseline. We also deploy the model zero-shot on a physical robot, where it follows goal-directed paths in unseen indoor and outdoor environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于图像目标导航的潜在世界模型，通过冻结DINO编码器与两种互补训练目标（自回归展开损失和单调成本排序损失）改善规划成本排序，在GNM数据集上达到最先进性能，并零样本部署于实体机器人。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型在图像目标导航中，规划成本（如余弦距离）排序不可靠，误导采样规划器（如CEM），导致导航性能下降。
AI.method: 构建基于冻结DINO编码器的潜在世界模型，并联合训练自回归展开损失（减少训练与规划差距）和单调成本排序损失（确保扰动动作序列获得更高成本），同时研究InfoNCE对比训练并发现其负面效果。
AI.result: 在GNM导航数据集上，方法优于NWM、DINO-WM、OmniVLA和NoMaD，实现最先进性能，方向误差比同编码器DINO-WM基线降低2.7倍；零样本部署到实体机器人成功在未见室内外环境导航。
AI.conclusion: 通过改进成本排序，潜在世界模型可有效提升图像目标导航性能，并具备实际部署能力；对比学习的负面发现提示需谨慎设计动作对比目标。

title: Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding: An Empirical Attribution
summary: Multi-page visually-rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) requires managing evidence that is sparse, spread across pages, and often exceeds a model's context window. Prior work has produced competing, largely untested claims about how these systems should be built. We attribute incorrect answers to three failure modes, representation, selection, and reasoning, and isolate each over a multi-page document understanding dataset by intervening on one while holding the others fixed. We find that vision is necessary but does not replace text extraction, that missing pages bound accuracy while distractors cost little, and that reasoners fail to integrate evidence across pages even when it is fully supplied. Prompting can shift reasoning behaviour substantially, improving some outcomes at the expense of others. We translate these findings into guidance for building such systems under a fixed compute budget.

AI.tldr: 本文通过干预实验隔离了多页视觉丰富文档理解中的三个失败模式（表示、选择、推理），发现视觉虽必要但不可替代文本提取，缺失页数限制准确性而干扰项影响小，推理器即使有完整证据也难以跨页整合，提示可显著改变推理行为。研究为固定计算预算下的系统构建提供了指导。
AI.motivation: 多页视觉丰富文档理解面临证据稀疏、跨页分布且可能超出上下文窗口的问题，此前研究对如何构建此类系统存在相互矛盾的主张，缺乏系统性验证。
AI.method: 在多页文档理解数据集上，通过控制变量法分别干预表示、选择、推理三个环节，固定其他两个环节，从而隔离各失败模式的影响。
AI.result: 视觉必要但不可替代文本提取；缺失页数显著限制准确率，干扰项影响较小；推理器即使获得全部证据仍难以跨页整合；提示能显著改变推理行为，但可能以牺牲其他性能为代价。
AI.conclusion: 多页文档理解系统的构建需综合考虑表示、选择与推理，在固定计算预算下应优先保证文本提取和页面完整性，并谨慎使用提示以平衡性能。

title: UnsDrive: Towards Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving in Unstructured Scenes
summary: End-to-end planning has shown strong promise for autonomous driving, but most existing methods are designed for structured urban roads and generalize poorly to unstructured mining environments. In such settings, weak road structure, terrain-induced occlusions, degraded visibility, and large unobserved regions make safe planning particularly challenging.
