On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. Our results indicate that a jointly trained geometry front-end is sufficient to bring calibration-free operation to query-based Gaussian reconstruction while staying within 0.7 dB PSNR of posed methods and matching their perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: FlexSplat是一个无需相机位姿的前馈框架，用于从多视图图像进行新视角合成，通过联合训练几何估计和Gaussian解码器，在保持紧凑表示的同时达到与有位姿方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于查询的3D Gaussian重建方法依赖于已知的相机位姿，限制了其在未校准场景中的应用。
AI.method: FlexSplat联合训练一个几何transformer和Gaussian解码器，预测每张图像的相机参数和深度，利用深度引导的Gaussian参数化和多视图可变形交叉注意力，并通过不确定性加权的深度一致性损失优化。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet-SRN和GSO数据集上，FlexSplat无需位姿和真值深度，即可匹配或接近有监督方法的PSNR（差距在0.7 dB内），并在GSO上达到最佳LPIPS。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练的几何前端足以实现无需校准的查询式Gaussian重建，同时保持紧凑的表示和高质量的视角合成。

title: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
summary: The deployment of autonomous robotic systems in chemistry laboratories is accelerating experimental workflows and providing the foundational data for AI-driven scientific discovery. However, despite the success of data-driven methods in acquiring dexterous skills, safety remains a primary barrier to their deployment in high-risk domains, such as early-stage materials chemistry experiments. Specifically, learning-based policies frequently struggle to distinguish between safe and unsafe actions, leading to overconfident extrapolation and potentially catastrophic failures. To mitigate these safety risks, we propose SAFE-CHEM, an uncertainty-aware framework designed for robust, learning-based robotic chemists. Our approach leverages an ensemble of recurrent neural network-based imitation learning policies to quantify epistemic uncertainty online through the variance of action predictions. By characterising the success-conditioned density of this variance using kernel density estimation, we introduce a hybrid control architecture that autonomously switches from the learned policy to a deterministic, rule-based backup controller when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated safety threshold. We evaluate SAFE-CHEM across three fundamental laboratory manipulation tasks, where our empirical results demonstrate that this hybrid strategy improves overall task success rates and reduces critical safety violations compared to traditional single-policy baselines. Finally, we demonstrate the practical viability of the framework through zero-shot sim-to-real transfer onto a physical Franka Production 3 robot manipulator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFE-CHEM，一种不确定性感知框架，通过集成循环神经网络模仿学习策略和规则备份控制器，提升机器人化学实验中的安全性。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的机器人策略在化学实验室中难以区分安全与不安全动作，导致过度自信的外推和灾难性失败，阻碍其在高风险领域的部署。
AI.method: 采用集成RNN模仿学习策略，在线通过动作预测方差量化认知不确定性，并用核密度估计刻画成功条件下的方差分布，构建混合控制架构，在不确定性超过校准阈值时从学习策略切换到确定性规则备份控制器。
AI.result: 在三个基础实验室操作任务中，混合策略相比单一策略基线提高了总体任务成功率，减少了关键安全违规；并实现了零样本sim-to-real迁移到物理Franka Production 3机器人。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-CHEM有效提升了学习型机器人在高风险化学实验中的安全性，同时保持了任务性能，并展示了实际部署的可行性。

title: The Authority Expectancy Effect in Multi-User Conflict
summary: We investigate how social authority (SA) signals interact with severity-based prioritization in large language models, operationalizing each axis as a model-elicited baseline -- the triage hierarchy and the SA hierarchy. Across four LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok) and three experimental phases -- resource allocation, fault attribution, and multi-turn dispute mediation -- we find that occupational authority, institutional documentation, and relational congruence can restructure model judgments in ways not captured by additive reweighting of authority cues. We formalize this pattern as the Authority Expectancy Effect (AEE) and characterize it through three properties observed across our conditions: it is reference-dependent, defined only relative to a pre-authority baseline; it involves evidential reinterpretation, in which identical content acquires different inferential implications depending on which party bears the SA signal; and it exhibits direction sensitivity, producing opposite outcomes depending on whether authority position and evidentiary cues align.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型中社会权威信号与基于严重性的优先级排序之间的交互作用，提出并形式化了“权威期望效应”（AEE），该效应具有参考依赖性、证据重新解释和方向敏感性三个特性。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在资源分配、故障归因和争议调解等任务中，权威信号可能以非线性方式影响判断，但缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 通过四个LLM（Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok）和三个实验阶段（资源分配、故障归因、多轮争议调解），操作化权威层级和分诊层级，对比基准评估权威信号的影响。
AI.result: 职业权威、机构文件和关系一致性会重构模型判断，且这种影响无法通过权威线索的加性重加权捕捉，表现为AEE的三种特性。
AI.conclusion: 权威信号与严重性优先级的交互是复杂的、情境依赖的，AEE为理解和预测此类效应提供了新框架，提示需谨慎设计AI决策系统以避免权威偏见。

title: LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. We propose Language-Aligned Dense perception for COD (LAD-COD), a framework that aligns top-down semantic target guidance with bottom-up hierarchical visual features. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. This design allows semantic information to guide localization while preserving the fine structural details needed for camouflage segmentation. Experiments on CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K show that LAD-COD obtains the best reported value in all 12 dataset-metric comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAD-COD框架，通过语言对齐的密集感知将顶层语义目标引导与底层层次视觉特征融合，以解决伪装物体检测中边界模糊和细节丢失的问题，并在三个数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 伪装物体检测中前景与背景高度相似，导致视觉判别性低和边界证据弱。现有基于大语言模型的方法仅将目标嵌入用于掩码解码，未显式指导密集视觉特征，难以保留低对比度边界和局部结构。
AI.method: LAD-COD采用可训练的层次视觉分支提取伪装敏感特征，并通过语言对齐双视觉融合（LADVF）将语言目标嵌入扩展为补丁级查询，门控融合残差信息，实现语义引导与细节保留。
AI.result: 在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K数据集上，LAD-COD在全部12项数据集-指标对比中取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 语言对齐的密集感知能有效提升伪装物体检测性能，为语言到掩码范式提供了新思路。

title: Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE
comment: Accepted to the actionable Interpretability workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction upstream causally controls refusal. But the detection direction is orthogonal to the change that actually writes the refusal, which is late and assembled over the course of generation rather than read off in a single forward pass. We attribute the write to a specific, localizable circuit, a mixture-of-experts writer held in check by an attention opposer and price every way of intervening on it: damping the opposer is cheap and effective, amplifying the writer is a cost wall, and surgical edits to the responsible heads do nothing. The circuit's organization, and the gradient method that exposes it, recur in a second, unrelated MoE model, while the lever's strength is architecture-specific. The result is a cost-measured map of where a multilingual safety repair can land, and what it costs

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制分析发现，多语言模型的安全对齐缺口并非源于危害检测失败，而是由于拒绝行为的写入电路在低资源语言中更弱，且修复该电路的成本因干预方式而异。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型的安全对齐不均衡，低资源语言更容易被诱导产生有害内容，但此前缺乏对这种差异的机制理解。
AI.method: 以sarvam模型为对象，使用因果干预、方向余弦分析和电路定位等方法，研究危害表示与拒绝写入的机制，并在另一MoE模型上验证。
AI.result: 危害表示在中间层几乎语言无关，但拒绝写入由特定的MoE电路完成，其中注意力抑制器可被低成本削弱，而放大器放大成本高，头部编辑无效。
AI.conclusion: 多语言安全修复的可行性和成本取决于干预方式，且电路结构在MoE模型中具有普遍性，但强度因架构而异。

title: Same Question, Different Answer? Measuring and Mitigating Prompt Privilege for Equitable AI Access
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into healthcare, education, public services, and everyday decision making. They should provide comparable assistance regardless of a user's literacy, communication style, or prompt-engineering expertise. However, existing research on prompt robustness primarily focuses on adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and prompt optimization, while overlooking whether semantically equivalent requests receive different responses simply because they are phrased differently. We refer to this accessibility challenge as "Prompt Privilege": users with greater prompting expertise systematically obtain better model performance despite expressing the same underlying intent.
  To address this problem, we present a unified framework for measuring and mitigating accessibility disparities in LLM interactions. We introduce Prompt Equity Score (PES), a quantitative metric for evaluating performance consistency across user populations, and Prompt Equity Transformer (PET), an LLM-based agent that automatically transforms user requests into semantically equivalent, accessibility-oriented prompts while preserving their intent. PET shifts prompt optimization from the user to the AI system, functioning as an intelligent accessibility layer between users and foundation models. Experiments on the MedQA benchmark demonstrate measurable prompt privilege, with statistically significant performance disparities between low-literacy and expert-prompting cohorts. Applying PET eliminates these disparities while preserving semantic fidelity, demonstrating that accessibility-oriented prompt normalization can improve equitable AI access. By introducing prompt privilege as a new dimension of AI accessibility and PET as a practical solution, this work advances system-centered accessibility and provides a foundation for more fair, trustworthy, and inclusive AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“提示特权”概念，指提示工程能力不同的用户即使意图相同也会获得不同模型性能，并引入提示公平性得分（PES）和提示公平性转换器（PET）来测量和缓解这种不公平。在MedQA基准上的实验证实了不公平现象，且PET能消除差异并保持语义保真。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注对抗攻击、提示注入和提示优化，而忽略了语言表达不同但语义等价时模型响应不一致的公平性问题，即提示工程能力强的用户会系统性地获得更好性能，这构成AI接入障碍。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：PES用于量化不同用户群体间的性能一致性；PET是一个基于LLM的智能代理，自动将用户请求转换为语义等价但更易于模型理解的提示，作为用户与模型之间的可访问性层，将优化负担从用户转移到系统。
AI.result: 在MedQA基准上，实验显示低读写能力组与专家提示组之间存在统计显著的性能差异（提示特权）；应用PET后，这些差异被消除，同时保持语义保真度，证明面向可访问性的提示规范化能改善AI接入公平性。
AI.conclusion: 提示特权是AI可访问性的新维度，PET提供了实用解决方案，推动了以系统为中心的公平性，为更公正、可信和包容的AI系统奠定基础。

title: SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model
summary: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SynVAR，首个针对VAR范式的免训练增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略抑制跨尺度误差传播，提升复杂场景生成质量。
AI.motivation: VAR在复杂多物体、多属性场景下存在性能瓶颈，现有扩散增强方法未能有效解决其特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题。
AI.method: SynVAR包含三个组件：全局引导确保早期空间结构合理，感受野约束缓解早期语义混淆，高频补偿恢复细粒度细节。
AI.result: 大量定量与定性实验表明，SynVAR显著提升了VAR对复杂场景的建模能力。
AI.conclusion: SynVAR有效抑制了误差传播，提高了VAR的生成质量，是该范式首个免训练增强方案。

title: How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review
summary: As large language models increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, we investigate a potential form of reward hacking: how rhetorical choices shape AI-review judgments when reported scientific content is preserved and how these effects vary across evaluation conditions. We construct a controlled corpus of 4,200 full-paper manuscripts derived from 120 anonymized ICLR 2026 submissions. Two LLM rewriters transform six rhetorical dimensions in opposing directions, and five LLM reviewers evaluate the resulting manuscripts under standard and strict protocols. We also test joint, recursive, and reviewer-guided rewriting. Our results show that rhetorical sensitivity is structured rather than uniform. Evidence framing and novelty stance produce the largest positive-negative contrasts in overall assessment, with scope framing forming a weaker second tier; the remaining dimensions have smaller or less stable effects. This hierarchy persists across human-assessed quality levels, but score movement depends strongly on the AI reviewer's original score: lower scores tend to rise, higher scores tend to fall, and directional contrasts are clearest in the middle ranges. More elaborate workflows do not reliably yield larger gains. Joint rewriting is strongly rewriter-dependent, reviewer guidance does not consistently outperform an unguided second pass, and repeated rewriting yields diminishing, configuration-dependent returns. Across conditions, the rewriter primarily determines the separation between opposing variants, whereas the reviewer determines the magnitude and sign of their score effects. Strict review lowers mean OA by 1.36 points without consistently changing rhetorical sensitivity. These findings identify when rhetorical presentation influences AI scientific review and motivate evaluation systems robust to content-preserving variation in scientific writing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验发现，LLM评审对论文修辞风格存在结构化敏感性：证据框架和立场新颖性影响最大，且影响方向与初始评分相关；更复杂的改写流程收益有限，评审者决定分数变化的方向和大小。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM参与科学评审，可能被修辞手段操纵，但缺乏系统性研究来揭示修辞选择如何在不同评审条件下影响AI评审结果。
AI.method: 构建4200篇论文语料（源自120篇ICLR 2026匿名投稿），用两个LLM改写器在六个修辞维度上做相反修改，五个LLM评审员在标准和严格协议下评审，并测试联合、递归和评审引导的改写。
AI.result: 修辞敏感性呈层级结构：证据框架和新颖性立场影响最大，范围框架次之；分数变化依赖初始分数（低分上升、高分下降、中段最清晰）；复杂流程不总是带来更大收益，且效果依赖改写器和配置；严格评审降低平均分但不改变敏感性层级。
AI.conclusion: 修辞呈现方式在特定条件下影响AI评审，提示需要构建对内容保持性写作变化鲁棒的评估系统。

title: DH-VLM: Dual-Horizon Cooperative Latent Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Large-scale language models for autonomous driving enable enhanced global understanding and long-horizon planning. However, when deployed in isolated vehicles, limited sensing range and occlusions restrict reliable decision-making, and the substantial computational and latency overhead makes on-board deployment impractical. Cooperative driving provides a potential solution by leveraging external agents for information exchange, but existing methods remain limited in semantic reasoning capability under practical constraints. To address these challenges, we propose DH-VLM, a dual-horizon cooperative latent reasoning framework that enables asymmetric semantic cooperation between the infrastructure and ego vehicle. The infrastructure aggregates multi-layer hidden states to form a global-reasoning horizon latent guidance, which is integrated into the ego model through an Infrastructure-Driven Latent Evolution mechanism for conditional latent refinement. This enables the ego vehicle to leverage long-range contextual understanding while preserving autonomous decision-making within its local planning horizon. Furthermore, we construct a cooperation-oriented question-answer (QA) dataset covering fundamental scene understanding and ego-personalized comprehension to support counterfactual and safety-aware reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DH-VLM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance, outperforming the previous state of the art by 14.6% in L2 error and 26.9% in collision rate. Compared with query-based end-to-end cooperative driving methods, our approach reduces the communication cost by 57.3% and GPU memory usage by 25.5%, while maintaining strong robustness against infrastructure guidance errors, providing a practical and robust paradigm for cooperative autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双视野协同潜在推理框架DH-VLM，通过基础设施与车辆之间的不对称语义协作实现全局理解和高效规划，显著降低了通信和计算成本，提升了驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在自动驾驶中虽有优势，但在单车部署时受限于感知范围和遮挡，且计算开销大；协同驾驶能解决这些问题，但现有方法在实用约束下的语义推理能力有限。
AI.method: 采用双视野（global-reasoning horizon和local planning horizon）的潜在推理框架，基础设施聚合多层隐状态形成全局指导，通过Infrastructure-Driven Latent Evolution机制融入到自车模型中，并构建了面向协作的问答数据集以支持反事实和安全推理。
AI.result: 在规划性能上达到最先进水平，L2误差降低14.6%，碰撞率降低26.9%；相比基于查询的端到端协同驾驶方法，通信成本减少57.3%，GPU内存使用减少25.5%，并对基础设施指导误差具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DH-VLM提供了一种实用且稳健的协同自动驾驶范式，有效平衡了全局理解与局部规划，同时降低了通信和计算负担。

title: SkillSmith: Enhancing Locally Deployed Agents via Automatic Skill Construction and Evolution
summary: LLM-based agent frameworks now act as personal assistants for multi-step tasks. Existing agent frameworks such as OpenClaw commonly follow the Cloud Agent depolyment mode using closed-source cloud LLMs as backbone model, which may expose private user information and incur repeated LLM-calling costs. Local Agents address these deployment concerns by depolying frontier open-source SLMs on user-controlled devices, but their task effectiveness still lags far behind Cloud Agents. Through diagnostic analysis, we reveal that the limited effectiveness of Local Agents with frontier SLM backbones mainly comes from missing environment knowledge caused by limited backbone model scale including environment rules and operation procedures. To supply such knowledge non-parametrically, context-efficiently, and without expert authoring, we present SkillSmith, a Cloud--Local Agent collaboration framework that uses Skill as a context-efficient knowledge carrier, automatic constructs Skill from Cloud Agent task exploration and evolves Skill using Local Agent execution feedback to enhance a frozen Local Agent. Experiments on daily agent task datasets AppWorld and WorkBench show that the automatically generated Skill enables the Local Agent with Qwen3.6-27B(SLM) to achieve task effectiveness comparable to Cloud Agents with frontier LLMs, outperform the strongest non-parametric baselines, reduce average actions per task from 36.1 to 9.9 on AppWorld-Normal, and generalize to other SLM backbone models without rerunning Skill construction.

AI.tldr: SkillSmith 是一个云-本地智能体协作框架，通过自动构建并演化技能（Skill）来为本地小模型提供环境知识，使其任务效果媲美云端大模型，同时显著降低动作数量和调用成本。
AI.motivation: 现有云端智能体框架存在隐私泄露和高昂调用成本的问题，而本地智能体虽然解决了部署问题，但由于模型规模限制导致环境知识不足，任务效果不佳。
AI.method: SkillSmith 框架将技能作为上下文高效的知识载体，从云端智能体的任务探索中自动构建技能，并根据本地智能体的执行反馈进化技能，以增强冻结的本地智能体。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 和 WorkBench 数据集上，使用 Qwen3.6-27B 的本地智能体在任务效果上与云端前沿大模型相当，超过最强的非参数基线，并将 AppWorld-Normal 上的平均每任务动作数从 36.1 降至 9.9，且技能可泛化到其他 SLM 骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: SkillSmith 证明了通过技能传递环境知识，本地小模型能够在任务中达到云端大模型的水平，为隐私敏感和高性价比的智能体部署提供了新路径。

title: LIBAD: A Multimodal Anomaly Detection Benchmark for Li-Ion Battery Electrode Manufacturing
summary: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向锂离子电池电极制造的多模态异常检测基准LIBAD，并针对弱相关模态和连续制造场景提出了DA-Core方法，通过结合特征空间覆盖和局部密度进行核心集选择，显著降低了误报率并提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有工业异常检测主要针对离散产品且依赖强相关的RGB和3D数据，而连续过程制造和弱相关模态（如可见光与X射线）未得到充分探索，导致现有方法在真实场景中迁移性差且误报率高。
AI.method: 构建LIBAD基准，包含对齐的双面可见光图像、高分辨率X射线和低分辨率X射线数据；提出DA-Core方法，在核心集选择时联合考虑特征空间的覆盖度和正常特征的局部密度，以紧凑的记忆库保留细粒度正常变化。
AI.result: 在核心集比例为0.05时，DA-Core将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，优于标准最远点采样；同时超过比例为0.20时的最佳标准核心集结果，并将推理时间减少43.9%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，设计面向过程制造的异常检测方法时，必须显式考虑正常特征的数据分布和模态间关系，而不能仅依赖现有的通用方法。

title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
summary: Robust robot control benefits from explicitly modeling state transitions, but video-generation world action models (WAMs) introduce substantial deployment cost. Existing latent WAMs avoid explicit future generation, but often compress predictive representations or separate predictive modeling from the representations used for action generation. We introduce JEPA-WAM, a latent WAM built in a pretrained V-JEPA space, which couples latent transition prediction with continuous action generation through a shared predictor. JEPA-WAM predicts a spatially structured joint current-future target that captures task-shared visual temporal structure between current and future observations, while preserving dense patch-level correspondence. Through the shared predictor, transition supervision directly shapes the backbone, from which dedicated representations are extracted for action prediction. The same design can also be instantiated in pretrained VLA policies while preserving their original perception and action pathways. On LIBERO-Plus, JEPA-WAM achieves 79.2%, the best result without large-scale robot-policy pretraining, while its pretrained $π_{0.5}$ instantiation reaches 86.3%, achieving the best overall performance. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world bimanual manipulation further demonstrate strong generalization under visual and spatial shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JEPA-WAM，一种在预训练V-JEPA空间中构建的潜在世界动作模型，通过共享预测器联合预测潜在未来状态和生成连续动作，在LIBERO-Plus等基准上取得了最优性能，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成世界动作模型部署成本高，而潜在世界模型往往压缩预测表示或将预测建模与动作生成分离，导致性能受限。
AI.method: JEPA-WAM在预训练的V-JEPA空间中，使用共享预测器同时进行潜在状态转移预测和连续动作生成，预测包含当前和未来观测的空间结构化联合目标，保留密集patch级对应关系。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus上，JEPA-WAM达到79.2%准确率，为无大规模机器人策略预训练的最佳结果；其预训练π0.5版本达到86.3%，为整体最优。在RoboTwin 2.0和真实双臂操作实验中，也表现出对视觉和空间变化的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: JEPA-WAM通过共享预测器有效结合潜在转移预测与动作生成，提升了机器人控制的鲁棒性和泛化性，且可无缝集成到预训练VLA策略中。

title: ELICITED: EHR-grounded Longitudinal Interactive Conversations for Information-seeking Triage Evaluation and Decision-making
summary: Emergency-department (ED) triage requires clinicians to rapidly identify patients who need immediate attention, determine who can safely wait, and prioritize limited clinical resources. At presentation, however, information may be limited to a chief complaint and initial vital signs. Clinically important details, including symptom onset and progression, associated symptoms, medical history, and medication use, are often obtained through focused conversation. Effective triage therefore requires clinicians to identify information gaps, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and update their assessment as new evidence becomes available. Most existing ED benchmarks evaluate acuity prediction from a fixed clinical snapshot. Although this formulation measures predictive performance after patient information has been assembled, it does not capture the interactive process through which triage-relevant evidence is elicited and interpreted. Existing medical dialogue datasets support the study of clinical communication, but dialogue statements are not always linked to temporally ordered events in the electronic health record (EHR). We introduce EHR2Dial-Triage, an agentic conversation-generation framework and benchmark grounded in MIMIC-IV-ED. The framework constructs triage conversations under explicit role-based and temporal information boundaries. Each accepted patient disclosure is linked to its supporting EHR event and the first dialogue turn at which it becomes available. EHR2Dial-Triage enables controlled evaluation of information elicitation, evidence use, five-level Emergency Severity Index prediction, and patient-facing communication across models and patient personas. It provides a structured setting for studying conversational triage as a dynamic process of clinical information acquisition, reasoning, and communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于MIMIC-IV-ED的智能体对话生成框架EHR2Dial-Triage，用于模拟急诊分诊中的动态信息获取过程，并支持对信息 elicitation、证据使用和ESI预测的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有急诊分诊基准大多基于固定临床快照进行 acuity 预测，忽略了实际分诊中通过对话动态获取信息的过程；而现有医疗对话数据集缺乏与电子健康记录（EHR）中时间顺序事件的有效链接。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于MIMIC-IV-ED的对话生成框架，该框架结合了角色和时间信息边界，将患者的每次披露与EHR事件及对话中首次可获得的时间点关联起来，支持受控评估。
AI.result: 提供了对信息 elicitation、证据使用、五级紧急严重指数（ESI）预测以及患者沟通的评估能力，并支持不同模型和患者形象。
AI.conclusion: EHR2Dial-Triage为研究对话式分诊作为临床信息获取、推理和沟通的动态过程提供了结构化环境。

title: How Far Do Foundation Models Transfer to Infant Signals? A Cross-Dataset Transfer Audit with a Unified Need Ontology
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Under review at AAAI 2027
summary: Public infant cry corpora are small, label-incompatible, and almost always evaluated one corpus at a time. We ask what this practice hides and what fixes it. Across four cry corpora screened by a multi-level leakage audit (byte-level and embedding-level deduplication plus a within-corpus train-test near-duplicate audit), we probe four frozen encoders and a handcrafted baseline under a unified five-class need ontology and shared task formulations. The audit exposes what single-corpus evaluation conceals: within-domain macro-F1 swings by 0.57-0.80 for the same encoder, cross-corpus transfer is negative on average (negative-transfer ratio 0.19-0.35, significant in 18 of 30 directed cells, BH-FDR), and 349 content-identical clip groups carry conflicting metadata labels across corpus distributions. The same audit, however, reveals a consistent way forward. Transfer into the noisiest corpus is consistently positive in effect size at matched training size and after near-duplicate removal, offering a practical recipe for small, noisy corpora. Frozen probes saturate at modest label budgets, while stabilized fine-tuning wins with full labels; domain-adaptive pretraining significantly beats stabilized fine-tuning at 5-10-shot (the 1-shot advantage is not robust to optimization-seed variance) but shows no significant advantage at 50-shot or beyond. In the tested binary, shared-label settings, ontology-mapped joint training wins in all four encoder-by-target combinations, whereas naively merging unmapped labels costs up to 37 F1 points. We release the ontology, mapping code, and audit pipeline, turning incompatible cry corpora into a usable joint-training resource.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多级泄漏审计和统一标签体系，系统评估了四个婴儿哭声数据集的跨数据集迁移与联合训练效果，揭示了单数据集评估的缺陷，并提出了实用解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有婴儿哭声数据集规模小、标签不兼容，且通常单独评估，掩盖了模型泛化能力和数据集间不一致性等问题。
AI.method: 设计了多级泄漏审计（字节级和嵌入级去重及近重复检查），统一五类需求标签，评估四种冻结编码器及手工基线，进行跨语料迁移和联合训练实验，并释放本体论、映射代码和审计流程。
AI.result: 单数据集内宏F1波动0.57-0.80，跨语料迁移平均为负（负迁移率0.19-0.35，30个单元中18个显著）；349个内容相同片段组存在冲突标签；向最嘈杂语料的迁移在匹配训练规模和去重后持续正向；冻结探针在少量标签下饱和，稳定微调在完整标签下更优；领域自适应预训练在5-10样本时显著优于稳定微调，但在50样本以上无优势；本体论映射联合训练在所有组合中获胜，而朴素合并损失最多37个F1点。
AI.conclusion: 单语料评估掩盖了严重的数据集不一致和迁移困难，但通过审计和统一本体论映射，可将不兼容的哭声数据集转化为有效的联合训练资源。

title: Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities
summary: Urban embodied intelligence requires coordination among heterogeneous agents (e.g., UAVs, ground robots, and autonomous vehicles) in dynamic cities. Simulators therefore provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating such coordination. Existing platforms nevertheless isolate different embodiments and decouple them from task design and evaluation. We present \textbf{Lingjing}, a simulation platform for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied intelligence in open-ended urban environments. Lingjing reconstructs and renders evolving cities from geographic data, synchronizes multiple physics engines, and exposes shared physical and structured urban state to agents. Its Gym-like interface supports user-defined ReAct agents and single- or multi-agent natural-language missions with configurable star or broadcast communication and resource constraints. Each episode becomes an attribution-ready replay that links agent trajectories and communication to relation-graph changes, resource consumption, and engine-based evaluations for systematic diagnosis. We evaluate twelve vision-language models on nine urban tasks under a shared engine-in-the-loop protocol. Controlled studies further examine communication, scalability, robustness, and failure provenance. Results expose persistent bottlenecks in grounding and long-horizon execution. They also show task-dependent coordination trade-offs and diminishing returns from added capacity, while heavier workloads further reduce success. Lingjing provides a unified testbed that enables reproducible end-to-end evaluation and systematic failure diagnosis in urban multi-agent embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Lingjing，一个面向开放城市环境的异构多智能体具身智能仿真平台，支持多物理引擎同步、语言任务、通信与资源约束，并提供可归因回放以诊断失败。实验揭示视觉语言模型在接地与长程执行上的瓶颈及协调权衡。
AI.motivation: 城市具身智能需要异构智能体（如无人机、地面机器人、自动驾驶车辆）在动态城市中协同，但现有仿真平台将不同形态隔离，且将任务设计与评估解耦，缺乏统一测试平台。
AI.method: Lingjing平台从地理数据重建动态城市，同步多物理引擎，向智能体暴露共享物理与结构化状态，提供Gym类接口支持用户定义ReAct智能体，以及单/多智能体自然语言任务，可配置星形或广播通信及资源约束。每个情节产生可归因回放，将轨迹与通信关联到关系图变化、资源消耗和引擎评估。
AI.result: 在共享引擎循环协议下评估12个视觉语言模型在9个城市任务上的表现。对照实验考察通信、可扩展性、鲁棒性和故障来源。发现接地与长程执行存在持续瓶颈，任务相关协调权衡，容量增加收益递减，重负载降低成功率。
AI.conclusion: Lingjing提供统一测试平台，支持可重复端到端评估与系统化故障诊断，揭示了城市多智能体具身智能的关键挑战，并促进该领域的发展。

title: Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization
summary: Users of modern platforms repeatedly need summaries of recent dialogue, but the window rarely contains enough context to be interpreted on its own. We formalize this setting as streaming dialogue summarization, where a system must summarize a current window using selective memory from an unbounded history under a fixed budget. We show that the central challenge is not how much history is accessed, but whether memory recovers the evidence that the current window presupposes. We construct a benchmark and evaluation protocol that separately assesses whether memory contains gap-resolving evidence and whether the generated summary reflects it. We propose ReMEMBER, a missing-evidence memory framework that conditions retrieval on unresolved window dependencies and refines retrieved chunks into evidence-dense memory under a fixed budget. Experiments on dialogues with histories up to 160K tokens show that ReMEMBER improves memory recall and gap-resolution completeness over memory construction baselines under the same budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出流式对话摘要任务，并设计ReMEMBER框架，通过条件检索和证据浓缩，在固定预算下有效解决历史对话中的证据缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 现代平台用户需要近期对话摘要，但窗口上下文不足，现有方法无法有效处理无限历史下的证据缺失。
AI.method: 提出ReMEMBER，基于缺失证据的记忆框架，根据窗口未解决依赖进行条件检索，并将检索块精炼成证据密集记忆。
AI.result: 在160K token历史对话上，ReMEMBER在记忆召回和缺口解决完整性上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 流式摘要的关键在于记忆能否恢复当前窗口预设的证据，ReMEMBER通过条件检索和证据浓缩有效提升了摘要质量。

title: Beyond the Plane: Coupling Planar Vehicle Dynamics with Three-Dimensional Road Geometry
summary: Simulation is crucial for developing and testing autonomous driving systems. In particular, the development of localization and control algorithms relies on an accurate vehicle dynamics simulation. However, most vehicle dynamics models are two-dimensional while real-world roads are three-dimensional. For example, effects from the three-dimensional road geometry on the Las Vegas Motor Speedway can increase the normal forces on the tires by more than 66% compared to the nominal load at standstill. As a result, even highly detailed planar vehicle dynamics models struggle to accurately reproduce the real vehicle's behavior. While solutions for three-dimensional vehicle dynamics exist, they are rarely adopted, computationally expensive, and complex. To address this issue, we present a novel method to couple planar vehicle dynamics models with real-world three-dimensional road geometry. We transform the planar vehicle state from the vehicle model's two-dimensional plane to its corresponding representation in three-dimensional space. Additionally, we calculate road-geometry-induced forces and moments and apply them to the planar vehicle model. We validate our approach using high-speed data recorded with a full-scale race car on the banked Las Vegas Motor Speedway. Furthermore, on synthetic tracks, we show that our method yields accurate results even in edge cases. Together, our results demonstrate that the gap between planar simulation and real-world three-dimensional roads can be closed without abandoning simpler planar models. To simplify adoption of our method, we provide the implementation as open-source software on github.com/TUMFTM/3d-road-geometry-coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将平面车辆动力学模型与真实三维道路几何耦合的新方法，通过坐标变换和力/力矩计算，在不放弃简单平面模型的前提下，实现了对三维道路效应的准确模拟，并在拉斯维加斯赛道高速数据上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有平面车辆动力学模型无法准确反映三维道路几何带来的额外轮胎法向力，而三维模型计算复杂且少被采用，导致仿真与真实车辆行为存在差距。
AI.method: 提出将平面车辆状态变换到三维空间表示，计算由道路几何产生的力和力矩，并将其施加到平面车辆模型中，从而实现耦合。
AI.result: 在拉斯维加斯赛车场高速数据上验证了方法的准确性，并在合成赛道上展示了边缘情况下的鲁棒性，表明能有效缩小平面仿真与真实三维道路的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能在不放弃平面模型的情况下准确模拟三维道路效应，并已开源以促进采用。

title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
summary: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PhyS，一种三阶段框架，通过构建真实物理交互视频数据集 PhyS-120K、物理感知微调和在线强化学习，将物理先验蒸馏到流式世界模型中，显著提升长时程视频生成的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 流式世界模型在长时程预测中常违反物理规律，现有方法依赖视觉预训练的通用教师模型，物理先验不足且蒸馏过程中进一步丢失。
AI.method: 构建 PhyS-120K 数据集（含刚体、软体、流体和相变视频及结构化标注）；对 14B 双向 DiT 进行物理感知微调；蒸馏为 1.3B 因果 DiT；使用在线强化学习与 Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) 优化物理一致性。
AI.result: 在 PhysicsIQ 上，PhyS 使教师模型提升 18.2%，使 Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing、Causal Forcing 分别提升 23.7%、14.8%、31.4%；在 VideoPhy、VideoPhy2、PhyGenBench 上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: PhyS 有效增强了流式世界模型的物理先验，改善了长时程生成中的物理一致性，验证了数据构建、微调和强化学习结合的有效性。

title: Skills in Weights, Memory in Code: Hybrid Learning for Memory-Dependent Robot Manipulation
summary: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies have acquired broad manipulation skills, but typically generate each action chunk from the current observation or a short fixed-length history. However, real-world manipulation is often non-Markovian, requiring robots to retain and reason over task-relevant information from long-horizon interaction histories to determine the next action. To address this challenge, we propose HyMeS, a hybrid learning framework that leverages the reasoning and memory-management capabilities of coding agents to steer a Markovian VLA for memory-dependent manipulation. Specifically, HyMeS learns low-level motor skills through gradient-based imitation learning, while a coding agent acquires high-level memory-management strategies through heuristic learning by iteratively updating an executable heuristic system from rollout feedback. Furthermore, we close the loop between steering and execution through multimodal stage-completion verification, which updates memory using proprioceptive signals and multi-frame VLM judgments. Compared with end-to-end memory-augmented VLAs, HyMeS requires demonstrations only for reusable motor skills rather than for every history-dependent task configuration, enabling data-efficient compositional generalization. On RoboMemArena, HyMeS improves mean cumulative success from 52.5% to 66.2% and mean task success from 41.3% to 60.1% over pi0.5, while outperforming PrediMem by 4.5 points in cumulative success and 14.5 points in task success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合学习框架HyMeS，结合编码代理的记忆管理与马尔可夫VLA策略，通过启发式学习和阶段验证提升长时记忆依赖的操控任务性能，显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实世界操控常是非马尔可夫的，需要机器人从长期交互历史中保留和推理任务相关信息，而现有VLA策略仅基于当前观察或短历史生成动作，难以应对此类任务。
AI.method: HyMeS采用梯度模仿学习低层运动技能，编码代理通过启发式学习迭代更新可执行系统以管理高层记忆，并通过多模态阶段完成验证（利用本体感觉和多帧VLM判断）闭环连接决策与执行。
AI.result: 在RoboMemArena上，HyMeS将平均累计成功率从52.5%提升至66.2%，平均任务成功率从41.3%提升至60.1%，优于pi0.5和PrediMem。
AI.conclusion: HyMeS通过只学习可复用技能而非每个历史依赖配置，实现数据高效的组合泛化，为长时记忆操控提供有效方案。

title: JustLLMGRPO: Radiographic Control for Chest X-Ray Generation
summary: Text-conditioned chest X-ray generation aims to synthesize realistic radiographs that faithfully depict specified findings. Existing work has primarily improved quality by updating image generators, implicitly treating prompts as fixed after CXR-domain adaptation. We show that this generator-centric view leaves a substantial optimization dimension underexplored. With a CXR-adapted Sana generator frozen, one-pass reformulation by an unmodified LLM reduces RadDINO-FID from 54.225 to 27.572. Prompt analysis shows that the LLM suppresses temporal comparisons, uncertainty, and other non-renderable report content while emphasizing visible radiographic findings. However, unconstrained reformulation reduces BioViL-T alignment with source prompts from 0.695 to 0.609. We therefore introduce JustLLMGRPO, which applies standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only to the LLM prompt policy while keeping Sana frozen. Group-relative radiology-aware image feedback retains visual focus while preserving source-prompt alignment. On CheXGenBench, JustLLMGRPO reduces RadDINO-FID to 26.780, a 50.6% improvement over direct prompting, while maintaining alignment (0.696 versus 0.695). It also achieves state-of-the-art distribution coverage and downstream classification utility. These results show that substantial performance can remain latent in how radiographic information is expressed to an adapted generator. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/JustLLMGRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JustLLMGRPO方法，通过强化学习优化提示词策略而非生成器，将胸部X光生成的RadDINO-FID从54.225降至26.780，提升50.6%，同时保持与源提示的对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有文本条件胸部X光生成研究主要聚焦于改进图像生成器，忽略了提示词表达方式的优化潜力。作者发现仅通过LLM改写提示词即可显著提升生成质量，但会降低与源提示的语义对齐，因此需要一种方法同时兼顾视觉质量和语义一致性。
AI.method: 使用CXR-adapted Sana生成器冻结，仅通过GRPO优化LLM的提示词策略。奖励函数结合组内相对图片反馈（如RadDINO-FID）和与源提示的语义对齐（如BioViT-L相似度），在保持视觉质量的同时维持对齐。
AI.result: 在CheXGenBench上，单次LLM改写将RadDINO-FID从54.225降至27.572，但对齐从0.695降至0.609；JustLLMGRPO进一步将RadDINO-FID降至26.780（相对直接提示提升50.6%），且对齐保持0.696（与0.695持平）。此外，在分布覆盖率和下游分类任务上达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化提示词表达而非生成器，可大幅提升胸部X光生成质量，表明生成性能仍有巨大潜力蕴含在提示词策略中。JustLLMGRPO提供了一种有效的提示词优化框架，兼顾视觉质量和语义对齐。

title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
summary: Test-time training (TTT) offers a lightweight way to adapt vision--language--action (VLA) policies from unlabeled deployment streams, but it remains difficult to use reliably in closed-loop manipulation. A shared adaptation space can mix incompatible task corrections, while an online update can alter subsequent actions before its consequences are known. We introduce a reliable TTT framework for VLA policies (VANE). VANE conditions prompt adaptation on the current vision--language context and learns from the future visual consequences of executed actions. Candidate updates are isolated from the live policy, evaluated on subsequent observations, and committed only when supported by future evidence, making adaptation selective and reversible. On SimplerEnv WidowX, VANE improves average success by $3.2$ percentage points over the corresponding TTT baseline. Results on Google Robot further show that deployment-time gains remain task- and embodiment-dependent. Together, these results demonstrate a constrained, evidence-based approach to adapting VLA policies during interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出VANE框架，通过基于未来视觉证据的选择性、可逆的测试时训练，提高VLA策略在闭环操作中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 测试时训练在VLA策略中存在共享适应空间和在线更新导致的不稳定性问题。
AI.method: VANE根据当前视觉语言上下文调整提示，从执行动作的未来视觉结果中学习，候选更新与实时策略隔离，仅在获得未来证据支持时才提交。
AI.result: 在SimplerEnv WidowX上平均成功率提升3.2个百分点，在Google Robot上显示收益因任务和具身而异。
AI.conclusion: VANE展示了基于证据的约束适应方法在交互过程中调整VLA策略的有效性。

title: AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaDINO，一种用于遥感变化检测的成对感知骨干适配框架，通过在冻结的DINO编码器中注入双时相交互，实现了高效且性能优异的变化检测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉基础模型（VFM）的变化检测方法通常独立编码两幅图像，导致骨干网络无法感知跨时相关系，与变化检测任务的双时相推理需求不匹配。
AI.method: AdaDINO框架包括三个关键组件：Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA)用于在冻结块后耦合双流并注入符号相反的共享时间残差；Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS)通过保留批量共享的通道子集来减少前馈网络计算；CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR)解码器重用编码器侧的变化响应进行从粗到细的预测。
AI.result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上，AdaDINO取得了与VFM基线相当或更优的性能，在SYSU-CD上提升最大。去除62.5%的FFN隐藏宽度后，F1分数仍达85.29%，并实现1.41倍的吞吐量加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过将双时相交互融入冻结的VFM骨干，AdaDINO有效解决了VFM与变化检测任务间的错配，同时通过计算优化实现了效率与性能的平衡。

title: AgriField-40K: Adapting Vision Models to Agriculture With Efficient Continual Pretraining
comment: Accepted at the Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) Workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Field-based agricultural computer vision is important for precision agriculture, yet it largely depends on expensive annotations and costly adaptation of large pretrained models. We introduce AgriField-40K, a field-centric dataset curated from 17 public resources and covering diverse crops, weeds, and field conditions. Building on this, we present AgriMAE, a parameter-efficient continual pretraining baseline that adapts a masked autoencoder pretrained on natural images by training only lightweight adapters. We further explore semantic feature reconstruction as an alternative pretraining objective and evaluate transfer across multiple tasks. AgriMAE consistently improves downstream performance and can match or even outperform full fine-tuning while using up to $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters, showing that AgriField-40K is a practical resource for continual pretraining in agricultural vision. Project page: https://dtu-pas.github.io/agrifield40k/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AgriField-40K数据集和AgriMAE方法，通过参数高效的持续预训练，仅训练轻量适配器即可在农业视觉任务上匹配甚至超越全量微调，同时大幅减少可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 农业计算机视觉依赖昂贵标注和大模型适配成本，亟需低成本、高效的预训练方案。
AI.method: 构建了包含多种作物、杂草和田间条件的AgriField-40K数据集，并采用掩码自编码器（MAE）进行持续预训练，仅更新轻量适配器，探索语义特征重建目标。
AI.result: AgriMAE持续提升下游任务性能，在减少9倍可训练参数的情况下，性能可与全量微调持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: AgriField-40K是农业视觉持续预训练的有效资源，AgriMAE为参数高效适应提供了可行方案。

title: SodaMem: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Graph Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that assist users over weeks of conversation must remember what is currently true, not merely what was once said. Flat RAG diaries and Markdown logs optimize needle retrieval but under-serve currency, provenance, and ordered temporal reasoning (Maharana et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2024; Packer et al. 2023; Chhikara et al. 2025). We present SodaMem, an evidence-grounded temporal graph memory that (i) extracts typed FactEvents with mandatory provenance spans, (ii) persists mention time, occurrence time, and validity with SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES edges under hybrid lexical-dense indexing, and (iii) answers via a planner-reader loop that gathers citable evidence before composing a final response. On LongMemEval-S, our store-of-record configuration reaches 92.8% accuracy (464/500; best of N=3) at mean $0.00161/question (approximately 18.3k tokens; median $0.00111 / approximately 14.6k) with deepseek-v4-flash. We compile public systems with estimable API cost into a cost table and cost-accuracy map; under these estimates SodaMem sits near the accuracy frontier at Flash-tier spend and strictly dominates several higher-cost, lower-accuracy points. Accuracy uses the same Flash model as reader and judge (self-grading); costs exclude ingest/judge and cross-system comparisons are compiled estimates rather than a single-harness bake-off.Our code is available at https://github.com/SodaMem/SodaMem

AI.tldr: 提出SodaMem，一种基于证据的时间图记忆系统，通过提取带来源的事实事件、维护时间戳和关系边，并采用规划-阅读循环来提升长期对话中LLM代理的记忆准确性和可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 现有平面RAG或Markdown日志难以支持长期对话中的当前事实追踪、来源验证和有序时间推理，需要更结构化的记忆机制。
AI.method: 构建时间图记忆，提取带强制来源跨度的事实事件；持久化提及时间、发生时间和有效性，并建立SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES边；使用混合词法-稠密索引；采用规划-读取循环收集可引用证据后生成回答。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval-S上，store-of-record配置达到92.8%准确率（464/500），平均成本$0.00161/问题（约18.3k tokens），在成本-精度图中处于前沿，优于多个高成本低精度系统。
AI.conclusion: SodaMem在长期记忆任务中展现出高准确性和成本效益，强调了证据基础和结构化时间推理的价值；但需注意自评偏差和跨系统比较的局限性。

title: Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production
summary: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架Uni-SLTP，同时处理手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLP），通过共享符号分词器和统一自回归模型实现双向转换。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将多个手语理解子任务统一，但理解和生产（SLT与SLP）方向相反，难以统一。为弥合模态差距并实现单一条件生成模型，需解决两大挑战。
AI.method: Uni-SLTP包含（1）共享符号分词器：将符号序列转为离散词符和隐表示，捕捉语义和重建信息；（2）统一自回归生成模型：将SLT和SLP表述为条件序列生成任务。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP在手语生成中达到更优动作准确性，同时维持有竞争力的翻译性能。
AI.conclusion: 验证了统一SLT和SLP框架的可行性，为双向手语-文本转换提供有效方案。

title: H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Medical data, by its nature, exhibit a high degree of heterogeneity on multiple levels ranging from (a) different modalities like images, text and time series, (b) diverse tabular schemata introduced by institutions and (c) completely unstructured textual information data provided by healthcare professionals. Data lakes are often used in medical data storage to consolidate all heterogeneous diverse data in a single, central location, where it can be saved "as is", without the need to impose a schema like a data warehouse does. Despite their flexibility, though, data lakes are notorious for the "data swamp" failure. Thus, providing a reliable data harmonization mechanism through metadata, without compromising integrity or flexibility, is a real challenge. To this end, knowledge graphs have attracted attention since they provide a dynamic way to depict relationships without a rigid schema-on-write approach. Additionally, another rigorous task relies on the interoperability of data: application of appropriate ML techniques on such a diverse nature of data is not an easy task, as a domain expert must decide the efficacy of a method to a specific data type or dataset. Metadata annotation can aid by tagging applicable operations, however this requires manual intervention, not to mention the plethora of existing datasets which lack such information. To tackle both challenges, in this paper, we propose a semantic data lake architecture that promotes data harmonization and incorporates a generative annotation process (i.e. LLMs) of non-labeled metadata collections to support the application of meaningful ML techniques. Building on top of this approach, we create a higher level of knowledge, identifying suitability of data with respect to applicable ML operations based on their data nature...

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于知识图谱和LLM生成注释的语义数据湖架构，以支持医学数据的协调和机器学习操作推荐。
AI.motivation: 医学数据高度异构，数据湖易变成“数据沼泽”，且元数据注释依赖人工，缺乏对ML操作适用性的自动标注。
AI.method: 设计语义数据湖，利用知识图谱表示数据关系，并通过大语言模型（LLM）自动生成非标注元数据，进而建立数据与ML操作适用性的关联。
AI.result: 该架构促进了数据协调，能自动标注元数据，并识别数据对ML操作的适用性，减少了人工干预。
AI.conclusion: 该语义数据湖方案能有效解决医学数据异构和ML操作推荐问题，提高了数据可用性与自动化水平。

title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience (ToE), a structured experience-management framework that aligns experience organization with the hierarchical reasoning process of LLM agents. Specifically, ToE organizes the experience into a shared tree of analytical perspectives and reasoning paths, whose reliability is calibrated through environmental outcomes to support systematic updating, transfer, and efficient retrieval. The experimental results on \textsc{Game of 24} and \textsc{FinEvolveBench} show that ToE substantially improves both problem-solving performance and efficiency. On \textsc{Game of 24}, ToE achieves a 31.4\% relative improvement in accuracy over the experience-free ToT baseline. On \textsc{FinEvolveBench}, ToE improves tsIC by an average of 41.24\% over the experience-free pipeline across 12 evaluation settings, whereas conventional experience-management methods often underperform experience-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出树状经验管理框架（ToE），将经验组织为与分析推理过程一致的树结构，以提升LLM代理在持续自我进化中的经验可靠性、可迁移性和检索效率，在Game of 24和FinEvolveBench上显著提升了问题解决性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有经验管理方法（如细化个体轨迹或抽象共享知识）的经验表示与推理过程脱节，导致反馈归因困难、跨任务迁移受限、更新和检索效率低下，尤其在结局级反馈的复杂推理任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出Tree-of-Experience（ToE）框架，将经验组织为共享的分析视角与推理路径树，并通过环境结果校准经验可靠性，支持系统性更新、迁移和高效检索。
AI.result: 在Game of 24上，ToE相比无经验基线（ToT）准确率相对提升31.4%；在FinEvolveBench上，相比无经验流程，tsIC在12个评估设置中平均提升41.24%，而传统经验管理方法通常不如无经验基线。
AI.conclusion: ToE通过将经验组织与推理过程对齐，有效提升了复杂推理任务中经验管理的能力，验证了结构化经验表示在持续自我进化中的优势。

title: Graph-Guided Safe Diffuser: Topological Graph Guidance for Safe Diffusion Planning
summary: Many diffusion-based planners enforce safety through inference-time guidance, but such interleaved trajectory deformations often degrade kinematic feasibility due to manifold rupture. We propose Graph-Guided Safe Diffuser (G2SD), a hierarchical framework that leverages a high-level topological graph planner to guide a low-level diffusion model. G2SD enforces safety at a structural level by abstracting the data manifold into a learned latent graph, on which high-level planning is performed. Continuous trajectories are generated by diffusion planners, which are conditioned on the graph node representations selected by the high-level planner. Theoretical analyses demonstrate conditions under which manifold rupture occurs in diffusion planners, and show that G2SD improves safety by reducing the constraint violation probability as the number of segments increases. Experiments demonstrate that G2SD substantially outperforms baselines, increasing goal-reaching rate without any collision from 40-50% to 98% in Maze2D navigation and also achieving superior task scores in locomotion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G2SD，一种结合高层拓扑图规划与低层扩散模型的层次化安全规划框架，通过结构级约束避免流形断裂，显著提升无碰撞目标到达率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的规划器通过推理时引导来保证安全，但这种轨迹变形常破坏运动学可行性，因为导致流形断裂。
AI.method: G2SD使用高层图规划器在学习的潜在图上规划，图节点表示作为条件约束低层扩散模型生成连续轨迹，并从理论上分析流形断裂条件和安全保证。
AI.result: 在Maze2D导航中将无碰撞目标到达率从40-50%提升至98%，在运动控制任务中获得更优分数。
AI.conclusion: G2SD通过结构级安全约束有效避免扩散规划中的流形断裂，提高安全性与任务性能，验证了层次化方法的优势。

title: Advantage-Guided Gate: Reshaping Open-Ended Reasoning for Vision-Based Spatial Intelligence
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in complex spatial scene understanding and reasoning tasks. However, their open-ended reasoning process is prone to decision errors and error accumulation, leading to instability in answer quality. To address this, we propose an advantage-guided gating framework that dynamically intervenes in and corrects deviations during the reasoning process. Specifically, we model step-by-step reasoning as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce Monte Carlo value evaluation on the reasoning tree to provide intermediate supervision signals. The framework includes Step-Advantage Gate and Trajectory-Advantage Gate, which dynamically select high-value reasoning steps and high-quality complete reasoning trajectories, respectively. During training, we perform supervised learning for the gates using reasoning trees generated via multi-branch sampling, and combine shared-parameter initialization with task-specific heads to achieve cross-task robustness and diversity. During inference, the model greedily selects high-value prefix reasoning steps while choosing the optimal reasoning head based on the problem type, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of the final answer. Furthermore, we constructed the Reasoning-Tree-160k dataset and performed two-stage learning on it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this advantage-guided gating framework effectively enhances the performance of benchmark MLLMs in visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks. The code is open to the public for research: https://github.com/LingLin-ll/Advantage-Guided-Gate.

AI.tldr: 提出一种优势引导的门控框架，通过推理树上的蒙特卡洛价值评估和双重门控机制，动态纠正多模态大模型在空间推理中的错误，提升答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在复杂空间推理中易产生决策错误和误差累积，导致答案质量不稳定。
AI.method: 将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，使用推理树上的蒙特卡洛价值评估作为中间监督信号，设计Step-Advantage门和Trajectory-Advantage门动态选择高价值推理步骤和高质量轨迹，结合共享参数初始化与任务特定头进行训练，推理时贪心选择高价值前缀并基于问题类型选择最优推理头。
AI.result: 在视觉空间理解与推理任务上显著提升基准MLLM的性能，构建并公开了Reasoning-Tree-160k数据集和代码。
AI.conclusion: 优势引导门控框架能有效增强多模态大模型在空间推理中的稳定性和准确性。

title: CORDA: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Harm-Centric Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Fourth International Workshop on Value Engineering in AI (VALE 2026), affiliated with IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: The key question in moral judgement is not simply whether someone chooses the "right" answer, but how they decide what matters most when moral principles conflict. Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) remain limited: most test whether models give morally acceptable answers, match human preferences, or avoid obvious violations, rather than whether they can prioritise between competing principles when no option is morally cost-free. We introduce CORDA (Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence), a benchmark for evaluating hierarchical, harm-centred moral reasoning in LLMs. Building on the morality chains formalism, CORDA tests 90 moral dilemmas involving trolley-style cases, medical trade-offs, resource allocation, and human-animal-robot conflicts across four ordered ethical frameworks: Utility, Utility + Agent Harm, Dual-Process, and Dual-Process + Agent Harm. Together, these frameworks test whether models can adapt their decisions when moral priorities change. Across ten instruction-tuned models from seven providers, we find a strong deontological default, with 9 of 10 prioritising avoidance of direct personal harm over reducing overall harm. Models also perform more reliably on categorical harm-avoidance rules, such as avoiding killing, than on outcome-based comparisons, such as minimising total harm, suggesting that they recognise moral red lines more easily than they reason through competing harms. Although all models respond to explicit chain conditioning, several fail to consistently follow specified priority orderings, such as humans over animals and animals over robots. CORDA addresses a central gap in LLM moral evaluation by testing whether models can move beyond default harm-avoidant responses and apply context-specified moral priorities. Moral reliability requires more than default restraint; it requires controllability under conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORDA基准，用于评估大语言模型在道德原则冲突时的层次化、以伤害为中心的道德推理能力。实验发现模型存在强烈的道义论默认倾向，且在不同道德框架下遵循指定优先级的能力有限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估多关注答案是否可接受或是否符合人类偏好，忽视了对道德原则冲突时优先级排序能力的测试。
AI.method: 基于道德链形式，构建包含90个道德困境的CORDA基准，涵盖四种有序伦理框架，测试模型在优先级变化时的决策适应性。对10个指令微调模型进行评估。
AI.result: 模型普遍偏好避免直接伤害而非减少总体伤害；在基于结果的比较上表现不如明确的伤害避免规则；部分模型在遵循指定优先级（如人类>动物>机器人）时表现不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 道德可靠性不仅需要默认的伤害回避，更需要在冲突情境下可控地遵循指定优先级，CORDA填补了此评估空白。

title: Security and Privacy Taxonomy Generation from Mobile App Reviews
summary: Mobile app reviews are a rich, continuously renewing source of how users experience privacy and security, yet existing taxonomies of these concerns are hand-crafted and cannot keep pace with the evolving nature of the data. Automating taxonomy construction is the natural response, but scalability is the core challenge: current LLM- and clustering-based methods are developed for scientific corpora of a few thousand documents and do not extend to app review collections numbering in the hundreds of thousands. We address this gap in two ways. First, we filter app reviews for privacy- and security-related content, yielding a comprehensive corpus of over 600K reviews. Second, we introduce TaxoScale, a pipeline that handles taxonomy construction at this scale by extending an expert-defined taxonomy via Recursive Hierarchical Clustering and LLM-based node naming. TaxoScale outperforms strong automatic-taxonomy baselines on path, level, coverage, and novelty metrics, and discovers novel branches absent from prior taxonomies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaxoScale管道，通过递归层次聚类和LLM节点命名，在大规模应用评论（超过60万条）上自动构建隐私安全分类法，优于现有基线并发现新分支。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私安全分类法手工构建，难以跟上数据演变；自动构建方法受限于规模，无法处理数十万条应用评论。
AI.method: 先过滤隐私安全相关评论，再用递归层次聚类扩展专家分类法，并由LLM命名节点。
AI.result: TaxoScale在路径、层级、覆盖率和新颖性指标上优于强基线，并发现新分类分支。
AI.conclusion: TaxoScale能高效处理大规模应用评论，自动生成时效性强的分类法，有助于理解用户隐私安全体验。

title: Tether-Inertial Localization for Planetary Drones
summary: Recent developments in planetary exploration have shown the potential of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), such as the Ingenuity helicopter that provided valuable mapping data. However, limited payload capabilities constrain the flight times and compute available for localization, which restrict their applicability. By providing a tethered connection, issues such as battery and computational constraints are offloaded to the base rover. At the same time, the cable can be exploited for non-drifting localization. This work presents a novel Tether-Inertial Localization approach that uses tether length and angle measurements to estimate the UAV position relative to its base. The method combines a computationally efficient analytical catenary model with a Gaussian Process (GP) residual error compensation. This accounts for systematic sensor inaccuracies and model limitations. Experimental validation across circular, triangular, and figure-eight trajectories with tether lengths up to 4.5 m and a total flight time of 37 minutes demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Using only tether-based position estimates for feedback, the analytical catenary model achieves an average RMSE of 7.4 cm, which is further reduced to 5.2 cm through GP-based residual compensation, one order of magnitude better than the state-of-the-art. These results establish Tether-Inertial Localization as a practical alternative to vision- and GNSS-based localization for Tethered Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (TUAVs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于系留无人机的绳索-惯性定位方法，通过绳索长度和角度测量并结合解析悬链线模型与高斯过程残差补偿，实现了高精度定位。
AI.motivation: 火星探测中无人机受限于载荷，飞行时间和计算能力受限，而系留连接可将电池和计算负担转移至基地车，同时利用绳索进行无漂移定位。
AI.method: 结合计算高效的解析悬链线模型与高斯过程残差补偿，使用绳索长度和角度测量估计无人机相对于基地的位置。
AI.result: 在圆形、三角形和8字形轨迹实验中，平均RMSE从7.4厘米降至5.2厘米，比现有技术高一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 绳索-惯性定位可作为视觉和GNSS定位的有效替代方案，适用于系留无人机。

title: MRBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Human Motion-Text Retrieval
summary: Human motion-text retrieval provides a rigorous means of assessing cross-modal alignment. Prevailing benchmarks are dominated by homogeneous indoor motions, imbalanced motion distributions, and oversimplified, repetitive texts, which hinder the reliable measurement of cross-domain and cross-granularity alignment. We thus introduce MRBench, a comprehensive motion-text retrieval benchmark featuring heterogeneous motions, broad and balanced category coverage, and reliable, discriminative, multi-granular descriptions. MRBench is constructed through a meticulously designed multi-stage data curation pipeline, which filters and balances candidates, verifies unambiguous semantic alignment, and generates motion-grounded descriptions at multiple granularities. The resulting benchmark contains 3,390 motions drawn from motion capture, in-the-wild videos, synthetic videos, and motion generative models, covering 118 fine-grained categories. Each motion is paired with concise, standard, and fine-grained descriptions, yielding 10,170 captions. Extensive evaluations of representative retrieval baselines on MRBench reveal a substantial cross-dataset generalization gap and pronounced sensitivity to query granularity. We propose a lightweight granularity-aware model anchored at a frozen standard-caption-aligned retrieval model. LLM-based concise and fine-grained captions provide pseudo-supervision for extra-branch granularity-specific motion extractors and text adapters. For inference, granularity-aware score fusion integrates global and adapted similarities while strictly maintaining score comparability across all description levels. The resulting model improves mixed-granularity retrieval without compromising standard-caption performance. We believe that our MRBench provides a comprehensive testbed for advancing motion-language alignment evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MRBench，一个包含异构动作、平衡类别和细粒度描述的动作-文本检索基准，并设计了一种轻量级的粒度感知模型，在保持标准描述性能的同时提升混合粒度检索效果。
AI.motivation: 现有动作-文本检索基准存在同质室内动作、分布不平衡和文本简化重复的问题，无法可靠评估跨域和跨粒度对齐能力。
AI.method: 通过多阶段数据整理流程构建MRBench，包括过滤、平衡、语义验证和多粒度描述生成；提出冻结标准描述对齐模型的粒度感知框架，利用LLM生成的简明和细粒度描述训练额外的动作提取器和文本适配器，并通过粒度感知分数融合进行推理。
AI.result: MRBench包含3390个动作、118个细粒度类别和10170个描述；评估显示现有基线跨数据集泛化差距大、对查询粒度敏感；提出模型提升混合粒度检索且不损害标准描述性能。
AI.conclusion: MRBench为动作-语言对齐评估提供了全面的测试平台，粒度感知模型有效解决了检索中对粒度的敏感性。

title: Rethink Before You Execute: Adaptive Execution for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future actions and the evolution of the environment. At each inference, a WAM generates a chunk of actions and the robot executes a fixed prefix before replanning. We argue that this fixed execution horizon is poorly matched to execution dynamics: the chunk reliability varies across task stages, so when to replan depends on the result of accumulated execution, not on the step counts. We propose TempoWAM (Timing Execution by Monitoring Progress Online), a lightweight plug-and-play execution scheme for WAMs. A Recurrent Progress Monitor first estimates task progress from the current observation, task instruction, remaining actions, and execution history; and an Adaptive Execution Protocol then evaluates whether the chunk is advancing the task to decide if replanning is needed. To bridge the training-deployment gap, the protocol is calibrated by a task-dependent calibration factor with online adaptation. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and real-world tasks show that TempoWAM consistently improves the efficiency-success trade-off of WAM execution. On real robots, it reduces WAM inferences by 26.9% on easy tasks while maintaining success, and improves success by 13.3 points on difficult tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TempoWAM，一种轻量级即插即用的执行方案，通过在线监测任务进度动态调整重规划时机，显著提升世界动作模型（WAM）的执行效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型在每次推理时生成固定长度的动作块，并执行固定前缀后重规划。然而，固定执行步数与执行动态不匹配：不同任务阶段的chunk可靠性不同，重规划应基于执行累积结果而非步数。
AI.method: TempoWAM包含两部分：循环进度监测器（Recurrent Progress Monitor）从当前观测、任务指令、剩余动作及执行历史中估计进度；自适应执行协议（Adaptive Execution Protocol）判断chunk是否推进任务以决定是否重规划。通过任务相关校准因子在线调整，弥合训练与部署的差距。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin及真实世界任务中，TempoWAM持续改善WAM执行的效率-成功率权衡：真实机器人上，简单任务推理次数减少26.9%且成功率保持，困难任务成功率提高13.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TempoWAM通过在线进度监测与自适应重规划，实现了更优的执行效率与成功率，且即插即用，可推广至不同WAM，提升实际部署效果。

title: Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?
summary: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了好奇驱动的视觉语言模型（VLM）在部分可观测条件下的空间理解能力，通过扩展ToS框架为EMRD流程，发现VLM决策常依赖文本先验而非空间证据，空间推理在低光下退化但不受纹理颜色影响，且其记忆机制与人类认知存在本质差异，可能导致不可预测的错位风险。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在安全关键场景中的应用增加，需要理解VLM是否具备稳健的空间记忆和决策能力，以及其决策是基于物理证据还是受偏见影响，并考察其与人类认知的一致性。
AI.method: 将ToS框架扩展为安全关键、目标驱动的流程EMRD（探索、地图、记忆、决策），分别通过环境覆盖和时间效率度量探索能力，空间保真度度量地图能力，心理度量指标评估记忆持久性，焦点度量评估认知决策。
AI.result: VLM在决策时常基于预训练文本先验选择撤离点而缺乏空间依据；空间推理在低光条件下退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响。
AI.conclusion: VLM的记忆机制与人类认知根本不同，这可能导致不可预测的错位风险，需警惕其在实际应用中的局限性。

title: PATH: Next-Interval Prediction via Autoregressive Tree Hierarchy on Tabular Data
summary: Interval prediction aims to achieve a target coverage level while producing intervals that are as short as possible. Many conformal regression pipelines first predict an uncertainty surrogate and then convert it into an interval through calibration or selection. This separation supports coverage calibration, but post hoc rules largely determine the final interval and do not fully use the learned output distribution. We observe that the resulting intervals have inherently hierarchical geometry: an interval can be recursively refined into nested subintervals, and binary trees naturally represent this structure. We formulate this hierarchy as next-interval prediction and propose PATH, which learns how probability mass flows from each interval to its next nested subintervals. PATH predicts a base leaf distribution and uses an autoregressive decoder to refine branch probabilities. Matching the distribution to the interval hierarchy aligns learning with extraction: PATH accumulates probability over adjacent output intervals and returns the shortest contiguous range reaching a selected mass. We compare PATH with 24 baselines for interval prediction on PATHBench, comprising 56 OpenML regression datasets. PATH substantially shortens the resulting intervals, achieving the lowest mean normalized length, 0.1473, while maintaining mean coverage of 0.9144. These results establish hierarchical output modeling as an effective approach for compact interval prediction on tabular data. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/PATH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PATH方法，通过将区间预测建模为层次化的下一区间预测，利用自回归解码器学习概率流，从而生成更紧凑的预测区间，在56个数据集上显著缩短区间长度并保持覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有区间预测方法通常先预测不确定性代理，再通过校准或选择转换为区间，这种分离虽保证了覆盖率，但后处理规则限制了区间质量，未能充分利用学习的输出分布，导致区间不够紧凑。
AI.method: PATH将区间递归细化为嵌套子区间，形成二叉树结构，将其建模为下一区间预测问题。通过预测基础叶分布，并使用自回归解码器细化分支概率，使分布与区间层次对齐，最后累积相邻区间概率并返回达到目标质量的最短连续区间。
AI.result: 在PATHBench的56个OpenML回归数据集上，与24个基线相比，PATH取得最低的平均归一化区间长度0.1473，同时保持平均覆盖率0.9144。
AI.conclusion: 层次化输出建模是表格数据上紧凑区间预测的有效方法，PATH显著缩短区间长度，为区间预测提供了新思路。

title: PE-Mamba: Bidirectional Selective Layer Aggregation for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image (AIGI) detection has become increasingly challenging due to the rapid advancement of generative models and the diminishing gap between synthetic and authentic content. Existing vision transformer-based detectors commonly rely on weighted-sum strategies to aggregate intermediate representations across transformer layers, often overlooking the inherently ordered semantic progression of hierarchical features from shallow texture cues to deep semantic representations. In this work, we propose \textbf{PE-Mamba}, a novel framework built upon a pre-trained PE-Core vision transformer with lightweight LoRA adaptation that introduces three complementary components for cross-layer feature aggregation and fusion. First, a bidirectional selective aggregator (BSA) processes layer-wise classification tokens through forward and backward selective scans, where the forward scan progressively accumulates shallow-to-deep forensic evidence, and the backward scan performs deep-to-shallow contextual refinement to reinterpret low-level cues in light of high-level semantic context. Second, a softmax-weighted aggregator (SWA) computes a learned global summary of all layer tokens as a complementary aggregation path. Third, a sigmoid-gated blend (SGA) adaptively fuses the BSA and SWA outputs via a learnable scalar gate, allowing the model to dynamically balance directional sequential evidence and global layer-wise aggregation. Extensive experiments on UniversalFakeDetect (96.6\% mACC, 99.5\% mAP) and AIGCDetect (95.3\% mACC, 98.1\% mAP) demonstrate that \methodname{} outperforms 18 detectors with superior generalization across diverse generative models, while training only 1.3\% of total parameters (0.13\% for LoRA alone).

AI.tldr: 本文提出PE-Mamba，一种基于预训练视觉变换器的AIGI检测框架，通过双向选择性聚合、软最大化加权聚合和门控融合，实现对跨层特征的动态聚合，在多个数据集上达到领先性能，且仅需训练1.3%的参数。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉变换器检测器主要采用加权求和方式聚合层间特征，忽略了特征从浅层纹理到深层语义的有序演进，导致检测性能受限。
AI.method: PE-Mamba采用预训练PE-Core变换器，并引入三个组件：双向选择性聚合器（BSA）通过前后向扫描捕获层级证据；软最大化加权聚合器（SWA）生成全局总结；sigmoid门控混合（SGA）自适应融合两者输出。
AI.result: 在UniversalFakeDetect上达到96.6% mACC和99.5% mAP，在AIGCDetect上达到95.3% mACC和98.1% mAP，优于18个检测器，且仅训练1.3%参数（其中LoRA占0.13%）。
AI.conclusion: PE-Mamba验证了有序跨层特征聚合对AIGI检测的有效性，兼顾高性能与参数效率，为生成图像检测提供了新思路。

title: Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as general-purpose educational and technical assistance systems, but their underlying infrastructure does not treat languages equally. One underexamined source of disparity is tokenization: semantically equivalent content can require substantially different token counts across languages, affecting API cost, latency, and usable context length before a model is invoked. We introduce the Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA), a reproducible benchmark for measuring tokenization premiums in technical tutoring content. TEA evaluates three widely used tokenizers, GPT-4o's o200k base, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B, on a 120-item Python debugging corpus translated from English into Bengali, Hindi, Arabic, Tamil, and Yoruba. Bengali and Hindi serve as the primary validated cases, while the remaining languages provide exploratory cross-script and cross-family comparisons. Across this corpus, Bengali requires (1.56\times) as many GPT-4o tokens as English, reducing a nominal 128k-token context window to an effective 82k-token English-equivalent capacity for the same semantic content. With the Qwen2.5 and Mistral tokenizers, Bengali requires up to (4.5\times) the English token count. Yoruba, despite using the Latin script, exhibits the highest GPT-4o tokenization premium at (2.37\times), indicating that tokenization inequity cannot be explained by script family alone. These results demonstrate that tokenization can create measurable economic and functional barriers, highlighting the need to treat tokenization as an equity-relevant infrastructure layer for underserved language communities, particularly where educational systems depend on low-cost or offline-capable AI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可复现的基准测试（TEA），用于量化不同语言在大型语言模型（LLM）中的分词成本差异。通过对英语、孟加拉语、印地语、阿拉伯语、泰米尔语和约鲁巴语的Python调试内容进行测试，发现分词不均衡导致某些语言（如孟加拉语和约鲁巴语）的API成本、延迟和有效上下文长度显著增加，凸显了分词作为公平性基础设施层的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在教育和技术辅助中广泛应用，但其基础设施对语言的处理并不平等。分词差异导致相同语义内容在不同语言中需要不同的token数量，影响成本、延迟和可用上下文长度。现有研究未充分考察分词在技术辅导内容中的不公平性，尤其是对低资源语言社区的影响。
AI.method: 作者引入了Tokenization Equity Audit（TEA）基准，一个包含120个Python调试问题的语料库，从英语翻译成孟加拉语、印地语、阿拉伯语、泰米尔语和约鲁巴语。评估了GPT-4o的o200k基础、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B三种分词器，计算每种语言的token数相对于英语的倍数，并分析有效上下文窗口缩减情况。
AI.result: 在GPT-4o分词器下，孟加拉语需要英语的1.56倍token，将128k上下文窗口缩减至82k等效英语容量；Qwen2.5和Mistral下孟加拉语高达4.5倍。约鲁巴语（拉丁字母）在GPT-4o下溢价最高（2.37倍）。结果表明分词不公无法仅由文字体系解释。
AI.conclusion: 分词不均衡为特定语言用户带来了显著的经济和功能障碍，影响依赖低成本或离线AI工具的教育系统。将分词视为公平相关的基础设施层至关重要，需要进一步关注和缓解措施。

title: When Confidence Fails: Overconfidence in LLMs under Uncertainty and Missing Clinical Information
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in medical question answering and clinical reasoning tasks. However, their reliability under uncertainty remains poorly understood which raises critical concerns for deployment in high-stakes clinical settings. In such environments, incorrect predictions are inherently risky, but confident incorrect predictions can be particularly harmful as they may mislead clinical decision-making. In this paper, we conduct a systematic behavioral analysis of LLMs under clinical information uncertainty. We propose an evaluation framework based on the MedMCQA dataset consisting of two complementary uncertainty settings. First, we introduce linguistic uncertainty cues through prompt modifications to simulate ambiguous clinical contexts. Second, we construct an answer removal setting, wherein the correct option is deliberately excluded mandating the model to recognize insufficient information and abstain. We analyze both model accuracy and confidence behavior using multiple calibration metrics including calibration gap, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Unsafe Confident Error Rate (UCER) across 500 medical questions.
